1.text: I have finally arrived the world of MapleStory. Through meeting new people, which included chatting and even receiving some help from them, I was able to reach a town called Amherst.\r\nJudging by the weak monsters showing up outside town, it doesn't seem like it's as dangerous as the place was made out to be...
The great weather seemed to be the norm here these days. \n\nI went around town for the past few days and this place is very peaceful.

3.text: (skip)

1.text: I ran into Manji, and was taken aback by his bad attitude. Did a famous warrior get hit, like John said? Anyway, I decided wander around Perion.\nI met Ayan, a little girl. She's dressed up as if she's the chief's daughter.

3.text: (skip)

0.text: August 2nd, 2006.\nWeather : Snowing in El Nath, even in the summer!

1.text: I'm still not used to this. Every time I feel warm in Orbis, I get smacked by icy coldness once I get to El Nath.

2.text: A disdainful old lady tried to see my horoscope by grabbing my hand. I ran away to El Nath, but the chill gave me a very nasty fever, and I am currently recuperating at Jade's house.

1.text: I finally heard about a monster named Balrog. It looks like my first order of business is to kill it. Now, to get to Balrog ... go past the Ant Tunnel ... someone told me this place has a humongous door... oh well, I don't care, wouldn't I get there just by going deep into the Ant Tunnel?\nI better go to Manji first and get myself healed...

A beginner may not strike fear into anyone, but the potential is limitless. The abilities may not be there just yet, so the beginners spend the majority of the time at Maple Island training for the big time.

2.text: Once the training in Maple Island is complete, move to Victoria Island for a whole new set of competition, bigger world to play around with and job advancement.

0.text: Even the very best at one point went through the growing pains of being a beginner. With diligent training, there are no limits to what you can achieve!

1.text: (1) #eEquipment Item#n\n  An item that can be equipped. Consists of a regular equipment item, which boosts the character's abillities, and cash item, which is geared more towards the appearance.

2.text: To equip an equipment item, open the equipment window and drag the item to the slot, or double-click on the item.

0.text: (2) #eUse Item#n\n  These items consist of potions that help recover HP and/or MP, scrolls that upgrade the equipment items, and other 1-time items. Double-click on the item to use it, and the item will disappear following its use.

1.text: (3)#e Etc. Item#n\n  These include items dropped by monsters, quest items, ores, jewels, and other miscellaneous items. Etc. items cannot be used on their own.

0.text: but they are pivotal in completing quests and other missions in the game.

1.text: (4) #eCash Items#n\nItems that can be purchased in the Cash Shop, primarily to customize the look of a character and create other visual effects.\n#rCash items can be purchased by charging your account with cash.#k

2.text: #L1##bReturn to the Table of Contents#k#l

1.text: (1) #eAP (Ability Points)#n\nPoints that can be distributed to your Strength (STR), Dexterity (DEX), Intelligence (INT), Luck (LUK), MaxHP, or MaxMP stats. You obtain 5 points every time you level up after your 1st Job Advancement. Press the #e#bAuto-Assign#k#n button to automatically distribute the points to the stat appropriate for your job.

0.text: #bStrength(STR)#k - The most important stat for determining the attack strength of warriors and pirates (Brawler and Cannoneer). Essential for equipping heavy weapons or armor.

1.text: #bDexterity (DEX)#k - The most important stat for determining the attack strength of Bowmen and Pirates (Gunslinger). As this stat increases, so does Avoidability.

0.text: #bIntelligence (INT)#k - The most important stat for determining the Magic ATT of Magicians. As this stat increases, so does the potency of magical attacks, as well as the amount of MP gained when allocating AP to the Max MP stat.

1.text: #bLuck (LUK)#k - The most important stat for determining the attack strength of Thieves. As this stat increases, so does Avoidability.

0.text: (2) #eSP (Skill Point)#n\nSP is a point that can be used to increase an Explorer-specific skill's level. Explorers earn 6 points by Lv. 10, then 3 points per level after that.

1.text: Starting from Lv. 101, however, double SP is earned if the level earned ends in 0, 3, 6, or 9.

1.text: When your character reaches milestone levels, you can take a job advancement and gain access to new skills!

2.text: After the job advancement, you will be able to learn job-specific skills, equip weapons appropriate for your job, receive an increase in HP, MP, Attack Power, and Defense, and gain more inventory slots.

0.text:
The levels for each job advancement are as follows:
#r
 - 1st Job Advancement: Lv. 10
 - 2nd Job Advancement: Lv. 30
 - 3rd Job Advancement: Lv. 60
 - 4th Job Advancement: Lv. 100
 - 5th Job Advancement: Lv. 200
- 6th Job Advancement: Lv. 260#k

1.text: Move to Victoria Island from Maple Island to proceed with your 1st job advancement.

2.text: You must then board a boat in Southperry bound for Lith Harbor to reach Victoria Island.

3.text: Finally, take a taxi or walk to a town to proceed with the job advancement.

0.text: (1) When a #eBowman#n\nreaches #rLv. 10#k, they can study under #bAthena Pierce#k in Henesys.

1.text: (2) When a #eThief#n\nreaches #rLv. 10#k, they can study under #bDark Lord#k in Kerning City.

2.text: (3)When a #eMagician#n\nreaches #rLv. 10#k, they can study under #bGrendel the Really Old#k in Ellinia.

0.text: (4) When a #eWarrior#n\nreaches #rLv. 10#k, they can study under #bDances with Balrog#k in Perion.

1.text: (5) When a #ePirate#n\nreaches #rLv. 10#k, they can study under #bKyrin#k in the Nautilus.

1.text: #eTitle : I have finally started writing a diary.

2.text: The Owl of Minerva has told me of the human custom of keeping a diary. I shall adopt the practice myself, though I already fret over the task.

3.text: Put simply, writing every day is not as easy as I had assumed.

1.text: #eTitle : My Statue

2.text: The humans elected a huget tower as well as build a statue of my likeness.

3.text: For them to make a beautiful statue out of these rocks made me realize how brilliant the humans are with their ability to create something. I was so impressed by the statue that I have decided to keep it inside my tower.

1.text: #eTitle : Lazy Afternoon...

2.text: \nIt's been a habit of mine lately to start each morning by staring at my statue while drinking tea. The more I look at it, the more I like how the statue resembles me a lot.

3.text: For humans to create a statue of my likeness with rocks... it still blows my mind.

1.text: #eTitle : Unwelcome Guest

2.text: \nToday, Papa Pixie came by for a visit wearing this round, weird-looking hat. He came wanting to buy some Water of Life so he can raise more Pixies.

3.text: I had to sternly tell him that the Water of Life is not for sale, much to his chagrin.

1.text: #eTitle : Busted Statue of Goddess

2.text: \n Today was a really rough day.

3.text: I heard a crack in the middle of the night, so I woke up only to find out my statue has been busted. Next to the crumbled statue was a footprint.

4.text: How dare that person to walk into my tower and have the audacity to break my statue!!

1.text: #eTitle : Papa Pixie's 2nd Visit

2.text: \nPapa Pixie, who came by a couple of days ago wanting the Water of Life, came back again, asking if I was interested in selling that water.

3.text: Amazingly, Papa Pixie offered to help fix the statue, which I was glad to hear. But then again, how did he know that the statue was busted in the first place?

1.text: #eTitle : A Visit by Human

2.text: \nToday, the humans paid a visit to the tower. I didn't want them to see the busted statue, so I had to hurriedly cover it up with some cloth.

3.text: Humans seemed to wonder why I put a cloth over the statue. I better get this fixed before they find out.

1.text: #eTitle : Lazy Papa Pixie

2.text: \nToday I felt like watering the garden, but when I arrived I found Papa Pixie idling instead of working on the statue.

3.text: He's nowhere near done fixing it, and yet he finds time to slack off? In my anger I chased him from the garden. Eventually I shall chase him from the tower!

1.text: #eTitle : Eak's Lecture

2.text: \nEak followed me around all day today, warning me that Papa Pixie is bringing odd pixies into the tower.

3.text: I am no fan of Papa Pixie either, but I was so annoyed by Eak's constant yapping that I ruined his cloud pieces to shut him up.

1.text: #eTitle : Restoring the Statue

2.text: Papa Pixie wanted to talk to me about the statue. He said he needed a new model for it, and wants me to help.

3.text: Apparently, all I need to do is walk into the statue for a second, and his magic will take care of the rest. Dare I dream that the statue will finally be completed?

1.text: Sayram, the Great Warrior, was perhaps the greatest swordsman in the history of Maple World. He alone mastered all of the warrior jobs, including Hero, Paladin, and Dark Knight.\nBut it is not his skill that earned him such adoration--rather, it is the tales of his courage and daring, which inspires explorers to this day.

0.text: It was rumored that he first got to know about magic through a travelling magician. Having to arrive at the remotely small village, the magician doesn't seems to be that great afterall, and the magic he saw could be of a basic magic trick!  But somehow, it still touches him to see a magical ray created out of nowhere, and through this, he firmly set a target to possess this mysterious strength.

In order to study magic, he arrived at Ellinia, but there are no magicians willing to take him in. Although the present Ellinia forest should be consider as opened, compared to its past when the Ellinia forest is a more secluded environment. To everyone, he was just a naive countryside kid who knows nothing about magic.

But he has never given up. The passion for learning magic has made him work even harder. So, he settled down in Ellinia and goes around researching on his magical studies. The people teased his eagerness. But not long after, the people around could not help but to agree with him, because... by the time he completed his first round of research, people became more aware of his talent!

During that time, Grendel the Really Old who is the elder of Ellinia, believed that he can attain and become an outstanding magician, and also entrust him with many matters. He loves to research on magic that can revive the forest, and also provides lots of help to the magical forest. Besides Ellinia, the magical forest, in order to create forest in other region, he start to research on related issues.

To have flowers to blooming in a deserted area... should be a difficult matter! In order to obtain more magical knowledge, he started researching on ancient magic, working hard to understand the books of magic research, and also obtained suitable result. During that time... he was named the Genius of Ellinia.

The Genius of Ellinia Forest! With the ability of his talent, he completed his second, third and fourth advancement within a short time period. Nobody is able to beat his time record. Yet, he shows no arrogance, and continue to research on more advanced magic. He... has always hungered for higher levels of magic...

However... could this never-satisfying of hunger for magic... caused an adverse effect? In order to obtain more powers, he gets contact with the forbidden ancient book! For other people, even they could obtain that ancient book, they will not be able to understand the content. But... because of what of a talent he is, he was able to self-learnt the ancient magic... After obtaining the power... he did not know realised the actual fact that it is a Dark Force...

The force of the black magic starts to control him slowly, gradually causing his personality to change. He used to be a cheerful and bright guy, deeply concentrating in his research, but he gradually changes into an extremely moody guy. People thought that his changed of personality was a result of over-tiredness, and never start to think strangely...

In the end... the black magic had fully controlled him, and he now could not use the original magic he has. But he couldn't reverse back the time, he could only immerse deeply into the practice of black magic, and now... he had made a grave mistake which cannot be reversed.

1.text: He had spent a part of his life creating new magic skills... Isn't he aware that the force he had created could harm the world? In the end... he suffered for his own fate!

0.text: For him, who has lost his human appearance, he decided to seek the punishments from the elders. Gritto proposed of destroying him, but Grendel the Really Old could not bear to do it to his beloved disciple. Hence, it was decided to seal all his magic skills and he will be watched by the Elders. As a talented magician, his future has definitely gone to a waste.
In the end... I am unable to write down the name of this rare talented magician in the historical record book...This is deeply regretted...

0.text: X/X/XX \nLately, I've had recurring thoughts...was it a mistake to fall deeply in love with a Fairy?  I confess that I did not count on suddenly being so aware of my lifespan in comparison to that of an immortal. It's funny that I worry already about what would most likely happen in 40-50 years, but... I am afraid of one day leaving Phyllia for good.  Such a painful goodbye...perhaps there is a way to avert it...

X/X/XX \nPhyllia is pregnant! I am filled with joy and curiosity to see how he or she will look. Phyllia mentioned how rare it is to have a baby between a Fairy and a human being, and she feels that it's a blessing from the Goddess, but... why can't I shake off this uneasy feeling? Since the baby is half Fairy, the baby should live a long time...but just thinking about leaving Phyllia and my child by themselves makes me queasy.

X/X/XX \nI began new research on extending one's lifespan. Some magicians were able to succeed in doing so, but...no known alchemists so far that have succeeded in this. (Alcaster did, but he's a magician as well...) Unlike magic, alchemy is a field where one needs to pay a price in order to achieve the desired result.  I'll just have to put my faith in the power of Alcadno.

X/X/XX \nI didn't even know where to start in terms of prolonging one's life, so I decided on a multiple experiment approach. Medicine and potions will be a good start, and I began working with Russellon.  However, I have met another fellow, with a variety of bright ideas. Maybe it's because he's a wandering alchemist who travels the world, but his opinions and views are radical.  Change the human body into a machine?

X/X/XX \nThe research is not going well. Mechanizing the human body  works in theory, but not in reality. The test subjects all cease being human. Why prolong my life if I would become a mindless husk? Never to hear laughter or crying again...what will I do?
...This is driving me crazy. I don't see this experiment working out. Phyllia's stomach is getting bigger and bigger by day. I am getting nervous. Too nervous. This is driving me insane.

X/X/XX \nMy precious child opened her eyes for the first time today. With her blonde hair and pale white skin...she looks exactly like Phyllia, even with her tiny wings. She is beautiful beyond compare. We decided to name her Keeny. Phyllia is quite fond of the name...says it's 'fitting for a fairy.' I must find a way to prolong my life, so I might see my child grow. But how? I will need a breakthrough soon...

X/X/XX \nWhile passing through the lab in the basement, I found a strange, ancient passage that I didn't notice before. It looked like a passage that was used a long time ago... It appears to link the two societies, as wel as lead further underground.  Never knew there was a place like this in Magatia. It seems shrouded in secrecy, and thus, such a secret bears further investigation.

X/X/XX \nI decided to explore the previously unknown, seemingly endless, underground passage. After descending for what seemed like an eternity, I encountered a mysterious  cave... It appeared to be some sort of lab. I had no idea about this. While cleaning up the hopelessly messy cave, I found a wealth of old data. What secrets are hidden among these pages?

X/X/XX \n...I found out an amazing, no, terrifying truth. The lab I found in the underground passage belonged to the Black Mage. I can't believe it. The lab of that evil human being actually still exists...? Then I came back to my senses, and realized that since the Black  Mage has been around for hundreds of years, he may know a thing or two about extending the lifespan.
...I have started to really delve into the research data the Black Mage came up with... I knew deep in my heart that I shouldn't do this, but... as long as I can extend my lifespan...

X/X/XX \n...The records that the Black Mage left behind... they seem eerily similar, even though he came up with these hundreds of years ago. Why is that? It's convenient in that it's easy to duplicate... but... something inside me feels not right about this.

X/X/XX \nThe alchemy of Magatia, and that of the Black Mage. The more I uncover, the more the link appears to be irrefutable. Please let it all be foul happenstance. And there is this hidden disciple, who wished to combine terrible magic and technology. Where has he gone...?

My fears are now confirmed. Not only is the alchemy of Magatia based upon the Black Mage, the very foundations of this land are steeped in his power.  For a deserted, dry land like this with no oasis to have a town like this... has to be because of the Black Mage. That evil Black Mage...for his work to be the genesis of what we all do these days...is that really the inconvenient truth about Magatia?

What would happen if the world found out that I had been using the studies of the Black Mage to extend my lifespan? A tempting thought, I must admit. Though it would earn me scorn from everyone in this land. The alchemists of Alcadno, Zenumist, the head of the Alcadno Society, even Russellon...even the wandering alchemist would no longer respect me. Even with all that...if the experiment worked out...

Unbeknownst to many Maple World travelers is a peculiar creature. When I was young, I came across one of these. It was a snail but much larger and older...It has been said that it has the longest lifespan amongst all Maple World snails.

Since I was young, I was always drawn to the snails. This one time when I was observing the little creature at a close distance, I noticed something. The snail was leaving a trail of snail shells of which some were green, blue, and red. But there was this one shell that stood out amongst the rest.

That shell had an array of rainbow colors. Its colors are so captivating that you know it's very valuable at first glance. Its value is cannot be compared with any treasure or jewel. I took that snail shell and guarded it with my life.
When I used the shell... I was able to achieve anything I wished to. The rainbow snail shell made all my hopes and desires come true! The thing I wished for was...!

#eA Guide to Using the Maker Skill#n

1.text:
-Written by -
Vaughn Lee, Stan & Louie
It's a skill that allows you to create an item through the fundamentals of alchemy. All you need are materials and a small fee, and you're set.

0.text: #e2. How to make the Monster Crystal#n

1.text: (1) Select [Monster Crystal]-[Monster Crystal] in the Maker Skill window.\n(2) Go to your Inventory and move the 100+ items that you've won by fighting level 31+ monsters to the Maker Skill window. \n(3) Click on the 'Make' button and you will have a Monster Crystal.

0.text: #bTip.#k Remember, there is, in fact, a chance that you may end up making a higher-leveled Monster Crystal!\n#bTip.#k Also, note that not all quest items or items dropped by monsters can be used.

1.text: (1) Go to the Maker Skill window and click on the type and name of equipment item you would like to make for yourself. \n(2) Select all the materials you will need to make the equipment item. Check each material. If you are missing some of the required materials, you will find that the icon for that material is in gray. \n (3) Click on the 'Make' button and your equipment item should be ready to go!

0.text: #bTip.#k By registering an accelerator or an upgraded gem, you can make yourself a higher quality item with better options.

1.text: (1) Go to the Maker Skill window and click on the type and name of the upgraded gem you would like to make for yourself.\n  (2) Check to see if you have all the required materials for making the gem. If you are missing some of the required materials, you will find that the icon for that material is in gray. \n  (3) Click on the 'Make' button and your upgraded gem should be ready to go!

0.text: #bTip.#k Note that there is always the chance that you may end up making yourself an intermediate grade or high grade gem!\n#bTip.#k If you collect at least 10 upgraded gems for yourself, you'll be able to refine them and turn them into an even higher grade gem.

1.text: (1) Go to the Maker Skill window and click on the [Disassemble] - [Monster Crystal]. \n  (2) Place the item you would like to disassemble in the ? slot. \n (3) Click on the 'Make' button and disassemble your equipment item to extract a Monster Crystal from it.

0.text: #bTip.#k The higher the quality of the equipment item, the more Monster Crystals you'll be able to extract!

1.text: (1) You don't need an accelerator or an upgraded gem to make yourself an item. All you need are the required materials.

2.text: (2) If you do not use the accelerator, there is always the chance that the newly made item may end up with either a better or worse set of options.

0.text: (3) Use the accelerator and you will definitely end up with an item with better options. If, however, the process is unsuccessful, the materials used for making the item will disappear.

1.text: Keep in mind that this method of making items involves a lot of trial-and-error. Combine various types and numbers of materials to see what kind of item you end up with! If you are unsuccessful and you do not get any items in the end, you won't end up losing any of the materials.

0.text: #bTip.#k You can always use an accelerator or upgraded gems, but with that comes the possibility that your item will be destroyed.

1.text: #bRosy Cheeks and a Big Heart#k

2.text: \nLittle real information is known about Santa Claus. This red-suited father of Christmas has made his tour around the world with his sleigh and reindeer (Rudolph included), putting gifts under trees and hanging from chimneys alike.

0.text: But a document discovered in Germany may have the secrets of this festive dynamo! From the excerpts of what appears to be a Diary of Santa Claus, even the big man himself did not seem to know why he started giving out presents to children.

1.text: Experts examining the diary believe that Santa was experiencing recurring dreams. They predicted that this could be the key to unravelling the secrets of Santa Claus!

0.text: The following is a page from his diary referring to the dream.

1.text: What a jolly, jumping time! Tonight I dreamed the dream I always have, and it was just as wonderful as it always is! Twas the 6th of December, in the great land of Turkey. I rode my flying horse through the sky, hunting with a band of my greatest friends, the divine beings! And what a funny bunch they were, laughing and calling me Odin, their lord supreme!

0.text: Tired from our hunt, and wanting for rest, we set down on the roof of a beautiful home to let our horses catch their breath. And lo, what did I find? A bounty of boots hung by the chimney, all piled high with heaps of carrots, grass, and sugar! Twas as if they had known we would visit their rooftop all along! With our horses well fed and our spirits high, we left them treats of our own. Candies and gifts for the children of the house.

a beautiful dream, but one that changed! As we flew across the world, my followers called me many different names. When we reached Germany, they called me Saint Nicolas! In the Netherlands, they called me Sinterklass. It's funny that all of these names sound like my original name, Santa Claus. Ho ho ho!
Unfortunately, my dream ended as it always did, with Johnson, my Director of Sales, coming to tell me about the latest quotas...

1.text: A recording of the conversation I had with the book containing Cygnus' thoughts.

2.text: \n#e#bWho are you?#k#n

3.text: My name is Cygnus.  This is the first volume of my books that contain my thoughts.  I am the emperor of Maple World although some call me the young empress.

4.text: #e#bWho is the Black Mage?#k

0.text: He tried to destroy the entire world long time ago... There are hardly any documents left about him now.  Things written about the Black Mage were so vile and evil that people didn't want to even think about it.

1.text: However, if the Black Mage is to be resurrected, that will truly be a nightmare no one wants to think about. Until now, a small group of elite knights have fought against the Black Mage, but the power of the mage is growing stronger.

It's a group of knights I created in order to defeat the Black Mage.  They are called 'Cygnus Knights'.  It's made up of people with different jobs and they fight against the Mage's followers.  Lately, it seems like the knights are getting tired.

2.text: So I've been recruiting more knights. The Black Mage's followers are those who are trying to resurrect him.

1.text: Ereve... A drifting island that has been enabled by the spirit's power to float around.  Because of the spirit's power and the power of the Benedict, any monsters or the Black Mage cannot enter.  Once I'm ready to recruit more knights, I am planning to settle down in one spot and start recruiting.
Benedict is very large... probably about hundreds of times bigger than you.  It's an organism of blessing.  Following tradition, Maple's emperor is chosen by the Benedict.

2.text: When the Benedict chooses a person, he or she becomes the emperor of Maple World and the Benedict will always protect them and never abandon them.

0.text: \n\n The Benedict is watching out for me from above Ereve right now as we speak.

1.text: A recording of the conversation I had with the book containing Cygnus' thoughts.

The Black Mage, who brought chaos to Maple World in the past, is about to be resurrected. According to our tactician, Neinheart, this state of peace will not last forever. Before the Black Mage is awoken again, we must grow our strength.

2.text: So in order to raise an army that will be able to fight against the Black Mage, I am recruiting for the Cygnus Knights.

1.text: Any maple adventurer can become a knight but there is one condition.  You must at least be level 20 or higher to create a Cygnus Knight character.

0.text: #e#bThen does my character transform into a knight?#k#n

1.text: No.  The knight character must be created as a new character.  However, I will use my special spirit powers to connect the character who volunteers for knighthood and the newly created knight character.

2.text: The two characters connected by the spirit's power can help each other as their own levels advance.

1.text: The original character will gain a skill called the 'Spirit's Blessing'.  This skill increases as the knight character's level increases.

2.text: #e#bThen can I volunteer for the knighthood right now?#k#n

3.text: No, not yet. We are still in the stage of preparation. The Chief Knights are working hard to finalize the recruitment process.

1.text: My faithful knight, Mihile, was born to be a warrior.  He was given the spirit's blessing in order to fight evil.  Those who first meet him say he's cold and intimidating, but he is my faithful knight with a good heart who is always protecting me.
Oz who used to be a Mage from the heavens has been blessed by the spirit of fire.  He is such a friendly and gentle mage.  He gets in trouble by Irena sometimes because he forgets to do his job

2.text: #e#bHead Knight Irena#k#n

3.text: Irena is an archer who has received the blessing of the spirit of wind. She often helps out with Oz's work who is a bit clumsy.

0.text: \n\nShe is always clam and objective and has a very beautiful heart.

1.text: #e#bHead Knight Eckhart#k#n

2.text: Eckhart is a thief who has been bestowed with the blessing of the spirit of darkness.  It's hard to see his face because it's always covered with a thief mask.  Because of his sarcastic remarks, sometimes he and Mihile butt heads but his heart is still very sincere.

1.text: Hawkeye, who has been blessed by the spirit of lightning, is a cheerful pirate.  He is always lightening up the mood of the knighthood.

2.text: However, when I give him an assignment, he takes it as seriously as anyone.  He is a great knight.

1.text: A recording of the conversation I had with the book containing Cygnus' thoughts.

2.text: \n#e#bWhat is a Dawn Warrior?#k#n

3.text: A Dawn Warrior is swordsman who is one with the spirit of light.  They are led by Mihile who has been bestowed with the blessing of the spirit of light to fight against evil.  Dawn Warriors draw the power of light on their sword.

1.text: A Blaze Mage is a mage that is one with the spirit of fire.  They are led by Oz who has been bestowed with the burning power of the spirit of fire.  These mages can use their magic to increase the spirit's power and freely control it.

A Wind Archer is an archer who is one with the spirit of wind.  They are led by Irena who has been bestowed with the blessing of the ever freely flowing spirit of wind.  Wind Archers can concentrate the spirit's power on their bow to shoot an arrow with great force.

A Night Walker is a thief who is one with the spirit of darkness.  They are led by Eckhart, who has been bestowed with the blessing of the spirit of darkness.  They can fight against enemies who cannot be destroyed with the power of light.  Night Walkers can not only use the spirit's power, but they can shoot out a powerful poison as well.

A Thunder Breaker is a pirate who is one with the spirit of lightning.  They are led by Hawk Eye, who has been bestowed with the blessing of the spirit of lightning which controls the power of electricity to strike an enemy.

0.text: #e#bI think I know all of them now.#k#n

1.text: You have read all the books on the Cygnus Knights.  By using the 'Cygnus Knight Quiz' book which will be dropped shortly, you can take the quiz and also receive reward as well.  I wish you good luck.  Until the recruitment for the knighthood begins, may the spirit's blessing be with you...

0.text: #bStrength(STR)#k - Essential for equipping heavy weapons or armor. The most important stat for determining the attack strength of Dawn Warriors and Thunder Breakers.

1.text: #bDexterity(DEX)#k - The higher this stat, the higher your accuracy and avoidability. The most important stat for determining the attack strength of Wind Archers.

0.text: #bIntelligence(INT)#k - The higher this stat, the higher the success ratio of magic attacks. It also increases Max MP and the amount of MP gained at each level up. The most important stat for determining the magic attack strength of Blaze Wizards.

#bLuck(LUK)#k - The higher this stat, the higher your avoidability. It also decreases the amount of EXP lost when a character dies. The most important stat for determining the attack strength of Night Walkers.

0.text: After waking up at Rien and experiencing the new world firsthand, you will complete the training both at the Cold Forest and the training center to make the first job advancement. Then, you'll slowly remember the abilities and skills that once made you a Legend.

#b1. Prologue
#b2. Definition of a Dragon
#b3. Dragon Types and Characteristics
#b4. Conclusion

1.text: Travelers of Maple World, what do you think of when you hear the word "Dragon"?

2.text: Do you think of the three-headed incarnation of evil, the vicious Horntail? Do you get the ticklish urge even this moment to go hunt that monster, since Dragons yield such high EXP?

0.text: Ah, but dragons are not monsters. They are another race of creatures, wise and intelligent.

1.text: Granted, there are monsters that resemble dragons. But dragons are so much more. Good and evil exist in every species. Surely, some dragons that can live in peace with us.

2.text: Sadly, some people think of all

0.text: Dragons as monsters that ought to be eliminated.

1.text: This book will provide detailed and practical information pertaining to Dragon types and characteristics, allowing you to know which Dragons to avoid and which to befriend.

2.text: Our hope is that this will help prevent misunderstandings and allow all races to live in peace with Dragons.

1.text: If you want to learn about the different types of dragons, you must first learn to define what a dragon is. For instance, Lizards have short limbs, a long body, and a tail that resembles a dragon's, but they cannot be regarded as dragons.

2.text: Dragons possess reason and emotions, and are capable of communicating with humans.

0.text: That is not true of Lizards, which explains why they can never be dragons.

1.text: In that sense, Drakes, Wyverns, Dragon Turtles, and Newts closely resemble dragons.

0.text: But they are not dragons! While they have sturdy scales and horns, tails, and the ability to exhale powerful breaths, they do not have a dragon's intelligence. Hence, they are known as Quasi Dragons. They are monsters who submit to powerful figures, often seen as the underlings of a real dragon.

1.text: There are many ways to categorize Dragons, such as scale color, horn shape, physical build, habitat, and Dragon personality.

2.text: However, since this book is meant for the general population, it will only cover the major types of common and special Dragons.

1.text: Categorizing Dragons by their scale color is the most basic and convenient method of distinguishing Dragon types.

2.text: In Leafre, this method is used to cateogorize and breed dragons.

3.text: Knowing a Dragon's personality can easily help you establish good rapport with the Dragon.

1.text: Dragons with red scales generally have the fire attribute. They must be approached with caution as they tend to be volatile, although they are just and loyal.

2.text: If you have irritated a Red Dragon, beware! The dragon may attack with Fire Breath.

1.text: Dragons with blue scales generally have the ice attribute. They are perceptive and cold-hearted. They can be petty, so do not get on their bad side.
Dragons with green scales generally have the wind attribute. They are playful and outgoing. They love forests and do not permit the destruction of nature.
Dragons with gold scales generally have the holy attribute. They can be overly carefree, as they are calm and peaceful by nature.

2.text: Gold Dragons will fulfill your requests no matter what, but no one can tell how long it will take.

1.text: These Dragons have black scales and black horns. While most dragons have horns that are a different color from their scales, #bBlack Dragons are entirely black, including their horns#k.

2.text: These Dragons generally have the darkness attribute, and although they are quiet and considerate, they can be insidious.

0.text: Now please note that this is not the only way to categorize Dragons. There are many Dragons that have scale colors that were not mentioned. Also, some Dragons may look like one of the Dragons mentioned above, yet have completely different personalities and characteristics.

1.text: If you wish to find out more about Dragons not mentioned above, please refer to Dragon Types and Characteristics (Vol. II).
\n\n- Leafre Dragon Conservation Union

Table of Contents

#b1. Prologue
#b2. Definition of a Dragon
#b3. Dragon Types and Characteristics
#b4. Conclusion

1.text: Sometimes, a dragon may physically appear to be a colored dragon yet have completely different characteristics.

2.text: These are known as special dragons.

1.text: While common dragons have plump bodies and long tails, Serpent Dragons more closely resemble a snake with their long body and distinctive facial features. They live by the sea and feed on small fishes.

2.text: Serpent Dragons, who are known for their mild temperament, do not attack first unless you intrude into their territory.

0.text: But they are also fair and logical, so they will permit entry into their territory if you pay a reasonable fee and only if -- they pay the proper fee.

1.text: Serpent Dragons do not have a specific attribute. They use both Ice Breath and Fire Breath, and have resistances to both. It is said they are proficient in magic, although they seldom use it.

0.text: Although it is hard to find Serpent Dragons in Victoria Island and Ossyria, it has been reported that a Serpent Dragon named Leviathan has appeared near Minar Forest.

1.text: At first glance, Onyx Dragons look like Black Dragons because they both have black scales, but Onyx Dragons have gold horns and their scales have a clear and mysterious glow.

2.text: They have the most unique growth process of any Dragon.

0.text: When an Onyx Dragon forms a contract with a person, their souls become linked. As the person grows, the Onyx Dragon grows as well.

An Onyx Dragon that enters a Spirit Pact will be spiritually linked to that person for eternity. Once that happens, the Onyx Dragon will finally recognize itself as a being and begin to develop intelligence. When its master grows, the Onyx Dragon will grow accordingly.

A spirit can develop endlessly, so an Onyx Dragon's growth potential is also endless. Onyx Dragons with good masters can acquire unrivaled amounts of power. Unfortunately, Onyx Dragons are said to be extinct.

1.text: Who is the most famous Dragon in all of Maple World? Ask a hundred people and every single one will say, "Horntail"! However, only a handful of people have ever seen Horntail and thus, only a handful of people know that Horntail is a Mutant Dragon.

0.text: Horntail can be categorized as a Black Dragon by its scale color. But because it is a three-headed Dragon, it is recognized as a special Dragon instead of a common Dragon. Each of Horntail's three heads has different abilities, and one of the heads is said to use a powerful luring skill.

Horntail may be an intelligent Dragon, but it is currently regarded as a monster in Maple World due to its vicious personality. Leafre is constantly recruiting members to join its expeditionary team to defeat Horntail, who has betrayed Nine Spirit and put Minar Forest in danger.

Of course, it is not easy to challenge Horntail. Currently, Horntail is the most powerful Dragon in Maple World. Of the three Dragon kings, Afrien went missing and Nine Spirit is in the process of recuperating from Horntail's betrayal, so Horntail stands unchallenged in Maple World.

1.text: Dragons in Maple World have their own thoughts, feelings, and will. Not all Dragons are good, but that isn't a good enough reason to regard all Dragons as monsters.

2.text: We can befriend Dragons, with the right mindset and diplomacy. So study them, and then give it a shot! Your life will surely be enriched.

1.text: \n\n- Written by John, A Retired Crew Member

This book is a collection of my experiences while out to sea as a crew member. My experiences reveal the thrilling life of a man of the sea, so read it if you wish to live vicariously through my adventures.

2.text: But remember: a true adventurer is someone who has firsthand experience of the world, and not a person who merely reads someone else's voyage log.

1.text: I have been on dry land for too long! Soon, I embark on a new voyage. This time, I board the Thunder Bolt under the command of Captain Alpha. He is well known, so I have high hopes for this voyage.
A lovely day. The voyage is off to a smooth start.
The wind is favorable. We're sailing faster than expected. Captain Alpha suggested we take a shortcut and sail through the Karibbean Triangle.

2.text: I'm sure the path is shorter, but that part of the sea is known for its atrocious weather and deadly reefs. That worries me.

1.text: We agreed to enter Karibbean Triangle as Captain Alpha suggested. I was nervous, but we haven't encountered any problems thanks to the proficient crew members. Actually, it's going extremely well.
Everything seems peaceful. I worried for nothing.
The sea is never this calm here. We must have luck on our side. Many crew members, including the Captain, have taken to napping on the deck to bask in the lovely weather.

I've been feeding the sea gulls. Now, they visit me. On land, I scare people with my threatening appearance, but the sea gulls don't care. It's so peaceful, being here with the gulls. And pirates aren't foolish enough to attack a huge ship like ours, so I don't have to worry about that, either..
We're about to leave the Karibbean Triangle. The expected 20 day voyage has been shortened to 10. I'm glad we followed Captain Alpha's instincts.
I'm so relaxed. I've been fishing. Something isn't quite right, though. The sea gulls have stopped visiting. Are we too far from their home now?
This sea is much too quiet. I'm uneasy. I mentioned this to one of the guys and he just laughed. I don't know whether I'm being mocked or not. I just hope I'm wrong...
I asked Captain Alpha if he thought anything felt strange to him. He laughed and said I worry too much. I hope he's right. He does have more experience than I do.

We were hit by a ferocious storm! The Thunder Bolt happened to be in the eye of the storm, which explains why the weather was so calm. No wonder those sea gulls stopped visiting. The storm will most likely get stronger. Will we survive this calamity?

When I opened my eyes, I was lying on a strange shore. The Thunder Bolt must be wrecked. I hope Captain Alpha and the others are okay, but I have to worry about myself. This island is covered in ice. I wrapped myself in a tattered sail I found. I still have my harpoon on me, so I can hunt. And at least I have my voyage log.

The island is covered in snow. I see some animals and plants but no sign of human life. Could this be a deserted island? I hope not. Anyway, it looks like rain. I should head inland and look for shelter of some sort.
I hid in a cave, but inside I found a dragon! I've only heard of them in tales... And now I see one frozen in ice. It has #bblack scales and four gold horns#k. If it wakes, I hope I can flee.

Luckily, the Dragon hasn't woken up. I was visited by some friendly faces today. The sea gulls! They recognized me, I think. I fed them some fish, and then a brilliant idea came to me. I ripped a piece of my clothing and wrote a note to whomever, asking them to rescue me. Then I tied it around one of the sea gull's legs. I hope someone finds it.
Constant rain. I waited all day by the shore but didn't see a single ship. No one sails through the Karibbean Triangle, so I only have one hope. The sea gulls...
I saw a ship! It reached the shore within seconds. The sea gulls had surrounded the ship and guided it to me. It is indeed a rescue ship! I'm saved! My sea gulls saved my life!

0.text: #fn궁서#A few years ago, there was a big fire in the Korean Folk Town. While everyone was busy putting out the fire, an important box that Chumji was safekeeping disappeared.

1.text: #fn궁서#With the disappearance of the box that maintained the innocent of the Korean Folk Town, Chumji had no choice but to close the entrance to the town.

2.text: #fn궁서#No one's entered Korean Folk Town ever since.

0.text: #fnArial#But just a few years later, Korean Folk Town suddenly started to change.

1.text: #fnArial#Kind Hongbu couldn't hold his anger, Kong Ji became lazy, and the Devoted Brothers envied each other.

2.text: #fnArial#Korean Folk Town grew twisted as people gradually began to change from their original stories. All of Ludibrium could be at risk if they keep diverging.

0.text: #fn궁서#All of Ludibrium could fall in danger if they keep diverging from their stories.

1.text: #fnArial#The Hero, summoned by Wiz's letter, made his way there to resolve the crisis. But his luggage was surprisingly heavy.

2.text: #fnArial#Upon arriving, the Hero discovered the librarian's assistant Moni in his luggage. Just as she was about to speak, they heard horrible moaning.

0.text: #fnArial#They followed the sound to Chumji, who had collapsed. With knowledge and courage, they created a medicine to wake Chumji.

1.text: #fnArial#They followed the sound to Chumji, who had collapsed. With knowledge and courage, they created a medicine to wake Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#The two found Hongbu at Nolbu's House, but lost him when he chased Nolbu into the mountains.

1.text: #fn궁서#The two find Hongbu at Nolbu's House, but unfortunately lose him as he chases Nolbu into the mountains.

0.text: #fn궁서#While Moni was tending to the fallen Nolbu's wife, the Hero chased after Hongbu into the mountains first. Although the Hero tries to stop Hongbu in front of the Goblin House, he falls to Hongbu, who awakened from the gemstone's power.

1.text: #fnArial#But something strange happened. Who would've thought that the gemstone's energy would be sucked into Moni?

0.text: #fn궁서#But something strange happened at that moment. Who would've expected that the gemstone's energy flowing from Hongbu's body would but sucked into Moni?

1.text: #fn궁서#Taking advantage of the weakened gemstone's power in Hongbu, the Hero succeeded in defeating him. But Nolbu, who still hadn't come to his senses in the midst of this turmoil, went on snubbing Hongbu.

0.text: #fnArial#Chumji explained what was going on as he stored the Stone of Rage. He also expressed surprise that Moni absorbed the gemstone's energy.

1.text: #fnArial#Hongbu was reminded of how he'd once carried the then bed-wetting Nolbu home in his childhood.

0.text: #fn궁서#Hongbu's anger faded, and he carried Nolbu back to town on his back. The Hero and Moni returned to Chumji with the #bStone of Rage#k Hongbu left.

1.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni went after the Qing Merchant and Oarsman, but could not find Shim Chung. As it happens, she'd been in the outhouse due to the prior day's meal.

0.text: #fn궁서#After asking them to find* the remaining 6 gemstones, he whispered something to the Hero. Quietly enough so Moni wouldn't hear anything.

1.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni then started collecting 5 gemstones.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Envy#k was attached to both of the Devoted Brothers. The two were envious over one woman.

1.text: #fnArial#In order to the end the love triangle, Moni had both of them propose, but neither succeeded.

0.text: #fnArial#One day, while collecting the gemstones, Chumji told Moni about her past.

1.text: #fnArial#All this time, Moni thought that she was an orphan adopted by the library...but she was actually discovered in Korean Folk Town after a big fire.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni was quite composed, for she had assumed that there was some kind of reason, since she remembered nothing before that.

1.text: #fnArial#Will Moni's past be revealed when Korean Folk Town is safe? Moni, Chumji, and the Hero could only hope so.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Greed#k was bound to the Lumberjack who bothered the God of Mountains every day for treasures.

1.text: #fnArial#In order to fix that terrible habit, the Hero and Nomi used a legend about a ghost.

2.text: #fnArial#After disguising themselves as ghosts with the help of the God, the #bStone of Greed#k fell off the Lumberjack.

1.text: #fnArial#Kong Ji had accidentally brought the Magistrate together with a girl he liked, leading her to pine for him from afar.

2.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Sloth#k fell off Kong Ji as she overcame her heartbreak. The Hero and Nomi took it to Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Sloth#k was bound to Kong Ji, who had grown lazy. The Hero and Moni decided to use the Magistrate to help her.
#fnArial#Now only the #bStone of Jealousy#k remained, but there was a fire behind the town, just like the one years back.

1.text: #fnArial#While the people were putting out the blaze, the Hero and Moni went into a hidden cave to find where the fire began.

0.text: #fnArial#The cave led to a cliff, where a maskless goblin was standing, infuriated that he failed the avenge the Nine-Tailed Fox.

1.text: #fnArial#Just in time, the people of Korean Folk Town had come to the cliff after putting out the fire. They were startled to see the goblin.

0.text: #fnArial#The Hero tried to stop the goblin, but was unable to stop him from awakening further. That was when Moni remembered her past.

1.text: #fnArial#Moni was the Nine-Tailed Fox, long thought dead. In the past blaze, it had become a human, later found by Wiz.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni, memories recovered, approached the goblin. The energy of the gemstone seeped into her as she approached, but she withstood it.

1.text: #fnArial#The goblin knew that Moni was the Nine-Tailed Fox, and tried to keep her away from the gemstone. But he was unable to stop her.

0.text: #fnArial#The Hero, who went to the bottom of the cliff after Moni, found her crying while holding onto the goblin, who closed his eyes forever in her arms.

1.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Sloth#k fell off Kong Ji as she overcame her broken heart. The Hero and Nomi then took it to Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni didn't leave the cave for a long time after the goblin died. Eventually, the townspeople's consolations gave her the strength to step outside.

1.text: #fnArial#Chumji handed Moni the box with the collected gemstones. Korean Folk Town had no need for them any longer, thanks to everyone overcoming their faults and Spiegelmann's new safety measures.

0.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni returned to the Helios Tower Library and told the whole story to Wiz.

1.text: #fnArial#Wiz had already learned the news from his mentor Chumji. He expressed countless gratitude to the Hero.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni decided to record everything that she and the Hero went through in a book.

1.text: #fnArial#She was hoping that someday the tale of Moni and the Hero would help people.

1.text: Writing a diary has been all the rage among humans lately, so I have decided to do the same.

2.text: But as a goddess, I thought a research log of my work would be more prudent.

1.text: I've begun developing a potion that causes the drinker to grow many times their normal size.

2.text: Any discoveries I might make can benefit others.

1.text: I believe I've finally found the right formula for the potion! The first batch is ready, so I plan to test its effectiveness soon.
Testing went... poorly, and this failure is disheartening. It's difficult to stay motivated.
I've decided to take a new approach with my research. I'm determined to find something that will help others!
My pride made me reckless. While I will take responsibility for my mistake, I fear it was too great for me to earn forgiveness. I may need help.

2.text: In addition, JM of Kerning City seems to harbor hatred for me. He is clearly opposed to my experiments.

1.text: Research is progressing smoothly, but I'm taking extra precautions to ensure there are no more mistakes.

2.text: I've tested the new formula with the first live plants, and the results are promising!

1.text: I was distracted today and mistakenly rinsed the potion remnants down the drain. My earlier caution was insufficient.

2.text: So little of the potion was actually left that I doubt anything will come of it, but there is still a nagging fear in the back of my mind.

1.text: Perhaps there was no reason for me to worry.

2.text: There's been no news of anything amiss as a result of my mistake.

1.text: It seems my greatest fear has come to fruition. King Slime has made his appearance, and we must gather Explorers to defeat Dyle.

2.text: These are merely temporary obstacles in the way of progress. I can help so many if I'm successful.

0.text: Rumor has it his first exposure to magic was a travelling magician. While they may have been simple magician's tricks, he was still captivated by what he saw. The beauty and elegance of creating something from nothing drove him to learn everything he could about this mysterious power.

He traveled to Ellinia to study magic, but no one would take him as an apprentice. Ellinia forest was not always the easily traveled place it is today, and his rural country backgroud did not inspire confidence in those he hoped would teach him.

But he never lost hope, and his passion to learn made him work even harder to succeed. He made himself a home in Ellinia and began studying everything he could find on the subject of magic. He may have been ordinary when he began, but he soon earned an extraordinary reputation among the people of Ellinia.

During that time, he earned the faith and trust of Grendel the Really Old, elder of Ellinia. Grendel had particular interest in magic that could not only revive the forest but that could also expand the forest beyond its borders into other regions. It was his greatest desire to see that wondrous place flourish, and he entrusted the young magician with the task.

While the idea of plants and flowers flourishing in a desert was unconventional to say the least, the young magician took up the challenge with enthusiasm. His intense research and resulting discoveries were highly praised, and he eventually became known as the Genius of Ellinia.

This savant of magic progressed in his training faster than any other and, to this day, remains one of the most prestigious magicians of all time. Through it all, he maintained his humility and continued feeding his insatiable appetite for knowledge.

But that hunger for magic soon became his greatest weakness. He began seeking ever more powerful magic to satisfy him, eventually turning to the dark magic contained within the forbidden ancient texts. Though he had become powerful enough to wield that dark magic, he did not truly understand its nature.

The more he used that magic, the greater the hold it gained on his mind, slowly warping and blinding him to the evil he would one day unleash upon the world. His old, kind nature began to fade, giving way to the darkness.
The wonderful magic that had first sparked his desire to learn was no longer a part of him. In the end, he became a mere slave to the darkness, but he had realized his mistake far too late.

1.text: How could one so enlightened become so damaged by darkness?

0.text: When he finally sought the judgment of the elders, he was but a shadow of his former self. Gritto wanted to destroy him, but Grendel could not bear to harm his former protege. Instead, the once-great magician was stripped of his power and spent the rest of his life under the watchful eyes of the elders.
His life may have ended in darkess and his name lost to time, but the legacy of his good deeds will live on forever.

1.text:
The most terrifying part of that dungeon wasn't the shadows cast by the flickering torches.
It was the sounds in its halls...the low, guttural moans, the endless pounding on the iron door. It'd drive anyone mad.

0.text: After exhaustive research, I finally discovered the shocking truth behind it.

1.text: We had been conducting experiments to see if we could transfer the girl's power of immortality to another test subject. But the recipient's body always rejected the magic. Every one of our attempts failed, and each time they did, the recipient vanished.

0.text: We thought nothing of it until the day a researcher went downstairs to retrieve supplies and discovered the horrifying byproducts of our work.

1.text: It was then that I realized... The test subjects' bodies were destroyed, but their souls...remained. What we found were their vain attempts to reform bodies they could never again inhabit.

0.text: The horror of what we had done was sickening. We had no choice but to seal the dungeon and turn a deaf ear to the tormented souls hidden below.

1.text: But Hekaton was relentless... bordering on inhuman... and the experiments continued for years. How many lives did we doom to an eternity of suffering?

"This book is about the story of the Great Warrior 
 The Story of Sayram..."

1.text: Sayram, the Great Warrior, was perhaps the greatest swordsman in the history of Maple World. He alone mastered all of the warrior jobs, including Hero, Paladin, and Dark Knight.\nBut it is not his skill that earned him such adoration--rather, it is the tales of his courage and daring, which inspires explorers to this day.

0.text:
And because of this, Sayram's stories were loved and passed on by many. 
Born in a village among the deep forests in Victoria Island, he had went through countless tough ordeals to become a true hero... Hopefully, Maple travelers will be touched by Sayram's story to self-explore and make great achievements.

1.text: - Author -

One day, while exploring the Garden of Darkness in Orbis, Sayram encountered a strange creature: it had a long white horn on an eagle's head, the legs of a horse, the tail of a lion, and a pair of mighty wings.\nThe animal stirred something deep within him, and so Sayram approached it. But when it saw him, it let out a screech and attacked.

0.text: \n\nThis animal possesses lightning speed, and wields a pair of giant wings that sent out strong gale of wind.

Sayram the Great Warrior, Aurelia the Magician, Lira the Bowman, Kalix the Thief, and Draken the Pirate. How one of Victoria Island's most famous party's met is a story yet untold.

Though they'd often joke about how they'd began as enemies, Sayram's allies stuck by him through every journey.

In the blink of an eye, Maple World descended into chaos.
Try as the Explorers might, nothing could stop the all-consuming flames of war from engulfing everything. At the height of the fighting, Sayram, Lira, Kalix, Draken, and I steeled ourselves for a major battle at *** Stronghold. Once we began, there would be no turning back. Sayram did his best to keep the mood light, but we all knew this fight may be our last.

It wasn't until long after the smoke had finally cleared, that Sayram put his hand on my shoulder and told me the bitter truth. The world stood silent. *** was gone. Half the stronghold had vanished. The casualties were countless. Lira, Kalix, and Draken were missing, with no bodies to confirm our fears.

They'd known what this fight might cost them, but I couldn't reconcile this fact with my feelings. It was all too much. I realized that a single fish had no hope of swimming upstream. When I asked to leave, Sayram sent me on my way on the back of his Griffey, Stormclaw.

It's been a long time since I returned to El Nath. yet, my magic research remains fruitless and the brilliant white drifts have done nothing to ease my heavy heart. All I could do is make symbolic graves for the allies I never got the chance to bury... I wonder if Sayram is safe.

Sayram rode into El Nath on Stormclaw. His skin was hatched with a multitude of scars, but his spirit remained unbroken. He said ***'s weapon, ***, was coming for the decisive battle. With so many Explorers injured or dead, victory seemed unconceivable. I protested his going, knowing full well there was no point in doing so.

Sayram shook his head and asked me to enchant his shield. He planned to face *** alone. In his eyes I saw the steely resolve of a man who would not be defeated. So I cast my best spells, while Stormclaw channeled its spirit into the shield. I also gave him the necklace that had saved my life at *** Stronghold. He thanked me and parted with a promise to return.

Some time later, news of Sayram's victory reached El Nath. I waited and waited, but Sayram did not return. One day as I was toiling away at my experiments, I heard the beating of wings outside. Throwing down my research, I hurried outside to find Stormclaw alone. All I could do was stand there with my arms wrapped around his neck, and my face buried in his plumage.

Stormclaw dropped my necklace into my hands and departed for Minar Forest with Sayram's shield in tow. The war wasn't over yet. I can no longer allow myself to be carried away by the current when he gave his life to protect us all. The river is rapid, but I will swim with all my might nonetheless.

1.text: I'll pass my learnings on to Alcaster. Then, I must be going.

Through meeting new people, which included chatting and even receiving some help from them, I was able to reach a town called Amherst.\r\nJudging by the weak monsters showing up outside town, it doesn't seem like it's as dangerous as the place was made out to be...
The great weather seemed to be the norm here these days. \n\nI went around town for the past few days and this place is very peaceful.

2.text: A disdainful old lady tried to see my horoscope by grabbing my hand. I ran away to El Nath, but the chill gave me a very nasty fever, and I am currently recuperating at Jade's house.

1.text: #eTitle: I have finally started writing a diary.

2.text: \nThe Owl of Minerva has told me of the human custom of keeping a diary. I shall adopt the practice myself, though I already fret over the task.

3.text: Put simply, writing every day is not as easy as I had assumed.

1.text: #e\nTitle: My Statue

2.text: \nThe humans erected a huge tower in my honor and built statues in my image.

3.text: For them to make a beautiful statue out of these rocks made me realize how brilliant the humans are with their ability to create something. I was so impressed by the statue that I have decided to keep it inside my tower.

1.text: #e\nTitle: Lazy Afternoon...

2.text: \nIt's been a habit of mine lately to start each morning by staring at my statue while drinking tea. The more I look at it, the more I like how the statue resembles me a lot.

3.text: For humans to create a statue of my likeness with rocks... It still blows my mind.

1.text: #e\nTitle: Unwelcome Guest

2.text: \nToday, Papa Pixie came by for a visit wearing this round, weird-looking hat. He came wanting to buy some Grass of Life so he can raise more Pixies.

3.text: I had to sternly tell him that the Grass of Life is not for sale, much to his chagrin.

1.text: #e\nTitle: Busted Goddess Statue

2.text: \nToday was a really rough day.

3.text: I heard a crack in the middle of the night, so I woke up only to find out my statue has been busted. Next to the crumbled statue was a footprint.

4.text: How dare that person to walk into my tower and have the audacity to break my statue!!

1.text: #e\nTitle: Papa Pixie's 2nd Visit

2.text: \nPapa Pixie, who came by a couple of days ago wanting the Grass of Life, came back again, asking if I was interested in selling the grass.

3.text: Amazingly, Papa Pixie offered to help fix the statue, which I was glad to hear. But then again, how did he know that the statue was busted in the first place?

1.text: #e\nTitle: Visited by Humans

2.text: \nToday, the humans paid a visit to the tower. I didn't want them to see the busted statue, so I had to hurriedly cover it up with some cloth.

3.text: Humans seemed to wonder why I put a cloth over the statue. I better get this fixed before they find out.

1.text: #e\nTitle: Lazy Papa Pixie

2.text: \nToday I felt like watering the garden, but when I arrived I found Papa Pixie idling instead of working on the statue.

3.text: He's nowhere near done fixing it, and yet he finds time to slack off? In my anger I chased him from the garden. Eventually I shall chase him from the tower!

1.text: #e\nTitle: Eak's Lecture

2.text: \nEak followed me around all day today, warning me that Papa Pixie is bringing odd pixies into the tower.

3.text: I am no fan of Papa Pixie either, but I was so annoyed by Eak's constant yapping that I ruined his cloud pieces to shut him up.

1.text: #e\nTitle: Restoring the Statue

2.text: \nPapa Pixie wanted to talk to me about the statue. He said he needed a new model for it, and wants me to help.

3.text: Apparently, all I need to do is walk into the statue for a second, and his magic will take care of the rest. Dare I dream that the statue will finally be completed?

1.text: It is the world's hottest liquid!\nNo strength is mighty enough to tame it!\nIt can melt anything--even the sun!

0.text:
The strength of the flame that is blazing hot forever...
Nobody actually knows how it was produced...
When it was produced...
Its purpose...

Many magicians tried and failed to obtain that miraculous power!

Its hotness is unbearable to mankind...
It dwells deep below the land.
No human is capable of controlling it...
let alone obtaining it!

There could be only one way to tame the heat: using all the snow from an ice field to cool it.\nBut even then, it could only cool a portion...\nLuckily, there is a place far below the land where the lava essence flows out...

Although it's a miniscule amount, it's enough to reduce a mountain to lava.

If a magician wants to gain ultimate mastery over flame...
they must consume the lava essence!

Only once the hot lava is trapped in their body
will they be able to gain full control!

If they do not have the courage to attempt it
they are not worthy of its might!

Ever heard of the ancient iceberg?
It is the world's coldest substance!
No strength is mighty enough to tame it!
It can overcome any chill--even that of the moon!

The strength of the ice that never thaws...
Nobody actually knows how it was produced...
When it was produced...
Its purpose...

Many magicians tried and failed to obtain that miraculous power!

Mankind lacks the grit to reach it,
as the chill of the ice canyon will freeze them to the bone.

Even if they were to make it,
they would need a giant's hammer to shatter it...

However, years of sunlight have weakened it.
Even if it is only a small portion, it can now be broken!

If a magician wants to gain ultimate mastery over ice...
they must consume the iceberg fragment!

Only once the frigid ice is trapped in their body
will they be able to gain full control!

If they do not have the courage to attempt it
they are not worthy of its might!

0.text: Rumor has it his first exposure to magic was a travelling magician. While they may have been simple magician's tricks, he was still captivated by what he saw. The beauty and elegance of creating something from nothing drove him to learn everything he could about this mysterious power.

He traveled to Ellinia to study magic, but no one would take him as an apprentice. Ellinia forest was not always the easily traveled place it is today, and his rural country background did not inspire confidence in those he hoped would teach him.

But he never lost hope, and his passion to learn made him work even harder to succeed. He made himself a home in Ellinia and began studying everything he could find on the subject of magic. He may have been ordinary when he began, but he soon earned an extraordinary reputation among the people of Ellinia.

During that time, he earned the faith and trust of Grendel the Really Old, elder of Ellinia. Grendel had particular interest in magic that could not only revive the forest but that could also expand the forest beyond its borders into other regions. It was his greatest desire to see that wondrous place flourish, and he entrusted the young magician with the task.

While the idea of plants and flowers flourishing in a desert was unconventional to say the least, the young magician took up the challenge with enthusiasm. His intense research and resulting discoveries were highly praised, and he eventually became known as the Genius of Ellinia.

This savant of magic progressed in his training faster than any other and, to this day, remains one of the most prestigious magicians of all time. Through it all, he maintained his humility and continued feeding his insatiable appetite for knowledge.

But that hunger for magic soon became his greatest weakness. He began seeking ever more powerful magic to satisfy him, eventually turning to the dark magic contained within the forbidden ancient texts. Though he had become powerful enough to wield that dark magic, he did not truly understand its nature.

The more he used that magic, the greater the hold it gained on his mind, slowly warping and blinding him to the evil he would one day unleash upon the world. His old, kind nature began to fade, giving way to the darkness.
The wonderful magic that had first sparked his desire to learn was no longer a part of him. In the end, he became a mere slave to the darkness, but he had realized his mistake far too late.

1.text: How could one so enlightened become so damaged by darkness?

0.text: When he finally sought the judgment of the elders, he was but a shadow of his former self. Gritto wanted to destroy him, but Grendel could not bear to harm his former protege. Instead, the once-great magician was stripped of his power and spent the rest of his life under the watchful eyes of the elders.
His life may have ended in darkness and his name lost to time, but the legacy of his good deeds will live on forever.

0.text: Unbeknownst to many Maple World travelers is a peculiar creature. When I was young, I came across one of these. It was a snail but much larger and older... It has been said that it has the longest life span amongst all Maple World snails.

Since I was young, I was always drawn to the snails. This one time when I was observing the little creature at a close distance, I noticed something. The snail was leaving a trail of snail shells of which some were green, blue, and red. But there was this one shell that stood out amongst the rest.

That shell had an array of rainbow colors. Its colors are so captivating that you know it's very valuable at first glance. Its value cannot be compared with any treasure or jewel. I took that snail shell and guarded it with my life.
When I used the shell... I was able to achieve anything I wished to. The rainbow snail shell made all my hopes and desires come true! The thing I wished for was...!

1.text: Travelers of Maple World, what do you think of when you hear the word "Dragon"?

2.text: Do you think of the three-headed incarnation of evil, the vicious Horntail? Do you get the ticklish urge even this moment to go hunt that monster, since Dragons yield such high EXP?

0.text: Ah, but dragons are not monsters. They are another race of creatures, wise and intelligent.

1.text: Granted, there are monsters that resemble dragons. But dragons are so much more. Good and evil exist in every species. Surely, some dragons that can live in peace with us.

2.text: Sadly, some people think of all

0.text: This book will provide detailed and practical information pertaining to Dragon types and characteristics,

1.text: allowing you to know which Dragons to avoid and which to befriend.

If you want to learn about the different types of dragons, you must first learn to define what a dragon is. For instance, Lizards have short limbs, a long body, and a tail that resembles a dragon's, but they cannot be regarded as dragons.

2.text: Dragons possess reason and emotions, and are capable of communicating with humans.

0.text: But Lizards are not dragons! While they have sturdy scales and horns, tails, and the ability to exhale powerful breaths, they do not have a dragon's intelligence. Hence, they are known as Quasi Dragons. They are monsters who submit to powerful figures, often seen as the underlings of a real dragon.

1.text: There are many ways to categorize Dragons, such as scale color, horn shape, physical build, habitat, and Dragon personality.

2.text: However, since this book is meant for the general population, it will only cover the major types of common and special Dragons.

1.text: Categorizing Dragons by their scale color is the most basic and convenient method of distinguishing Dragon types.

2.text: In Leafre, this method is used to categorize and breed dragons.

3.text: Let's begin.

1.text: Dragons with red scales generally have the fire attribute. They must be approached with caution as they tend to be volatile, although they are just and loyal.

2.text: If you have irritated a Red Dragon, beware! The dragon may attack with Fire Breath.

1.text: Dragons with blue scales generally have the ice attribute. They are perceptive and cold-hearted. They can be petty, so do not get on their bad side.
Dragons with green scales generally have the wind attribute. They are playful and outgoing. They love forests and do not permit the destruction of nature.
Dragons with gold scales generally have the holy attribute. They can be overly carefree, as they are calm and peaceful by nature.

2.text: They will fulfill your requests no matter what, but no one can tell how long it will take.

1.text: These Dragons have black scales and black horns. While most dragons have horns that are a different color from their scales, #bBlack Dragons are entirely black, including their horns#k.

2.text: These Dragons generally have the darkness attribute, and although they are quiet and considerate, they can be insidious.

0.text: Now please note that this is not the only way to categorize Dragons. There are many Dragons that have scale colors that were not mentioned. Also, some Dragons may look like one of the Dragons mentioned above, yet have completely different personalities and characteristics.

1.text: If you wish to find out more about Dragons not mentioned above, please refer to Dragon Types and Characteristics (Vol. II).
\n\n- Leafre Dragon Conservation Union
