1.text: Sometimes, a dragon may physically appear to be a colored dragon yet have completely different characteristics.

2.text: These are known as special dragons.

1.text: While common dragons have plump bodies and long tails, Serpent Dragons more closely resemble a snake with their long body and distinctive facial features. They live by the sea and feed on small fishes.

2.text: Serpent Dragons, who are known for their mild temperament, do not attack first unless you intrude into their territory.

0.text: Serpent Dragons do not have a specific attribute. They use both Ice Breath and Fire Breath, and have resistances to both. It is said they are proficient in magic, although they seldom use it.

1.text: Although it is hard to find Serpent Dragons in Victoria Island and Ossyria, it has been reported that a Serpent Dragon named Leviathan has appeared near Minar Forest.
At first glance, Onyx Dragons resemble Black Dragons, but upon closer inspection, you'll find that their scales are glossier and their horns are golden.

2.text: Beyond appearances, Onyx Dragons also develop uniquely among Dragons.

0.text: Their physical growth is directly tied to their mental growth. A newborn Onyx Dragon will remain feeble unless it is able to form a pact with another species.

An Onyx Dragon that enters a Spirit Pact will be spiritually linked to that person for eternity. Once that happens, the Onyx Dragon will finally recognize itself as a being and begin to develop intelligence. When its master grows, the Onyx Dragon will grow accordingly.

A spirit can develop endlessly, so an Onyx Dragon's growth potential is also endless. Onyx Dragons with good masters can acquire unrivaled amounts of power. Unfortunately, Onyx Dragons are said to be extinct.

1.text: Who is the most famous Dragon in all of Maple World? Ask a hundred people and every single one will say, "Horntail"! However, only a handful of people have ever seen Horntail and thus, only a handful of people know that Horntail is a Mutant Dragon.

0.text: Horntail can be categorized as a Black Dragon by its scale color. But because it is a three-headed Dragon, it is recognized as a special Dragon instead of a common Dragon. Each of Horntail's three heads has different abilities, and one of the heads is said to use a powerful luring skill.

One example is Horntail, an intelligent Dragon regarded as a monster in Maple World due to its vicious personality. Leafre is constantly recruiting members to join its expeditionary team to defeat Horntail, who has betrayed Nine Spirit and put Minar Forest in danger.

Of course, it is not easy to challenge Horntail. Currently, Horntail is the most powerful Dragon in Maple World. Of the three Dragon kings, Afrien went missing and Nine Spirit is in the process of recuperating from Horntail's betrayal, so Horntail stands unchallenged in Maple World.

1.text: Dragons in Maple World have their own thoughts, feelings, and will. Not all Dragons are good, but that isn't a good enough reason to regard all Dragons as monsters.

2.text: We can befriend Dragons, with the right mindset and diplomacy. So study them, and then give it a shot! Your life will surely be enriched.

1.text: \n\n- Written by John, A Retired Crew Member

This book is a collection of my experiences while out to sea as a crew member. My experiences reveal the thrilling life of a man of the sea, so read it if you wish to live vicariously through my adventures.

2.text: But remember: a true adventurer is someone who has firsthand experience of the world, and not a person who merely reads someone else's voyage log.

1.text: I have been on dry land for too long! Soon, I embark on a new voyage. This time, I board the Thunder Bolt under the command of Captain Alpha. He is well known, so I have high hopes for this voyage.
A lovely day. The voyage is off to a smooth start.
The wind is favorable. We're sailing faster than expected. Captain Alpha suggested we take a shortcut and sail through the Karibbean Triangle.

2.text: I'm sure the path is shorter, but that part of the sea is known for its atrocious weather and deadly reefs. That worries me.

1.text: We agreed to enter Karibbean Triangle as Captain Alpha suggested. I was nervous, but we haven't encountered any problems thanks to the proficient crew members. Actually, it's going extremely well.
Everything seems peaceful. I worried for nothing.
The sea is never this calm here. We must have luck on our side. Many crew members, including the Captain, have taken to napping on the deck to bask in the lovely weather.

I've been feeding the sea gulls. Now, they visit me. On land, I scare people with my threatening appearance, but the sea gulls don't care. It's so peaceful, being here with the gulls. And pirates aren't foolish enough to attack a huge ship like ours, so I don't have to worry about that, either.
We're about to leave the Karibbean Triangle. The expected 20 day voyage has been shortened to 10. I'm glad we followed Captain Alpha's instincts.
I'm so relaxed. I've been fishing. Something isn't quite right, though. The sea gulls have stopped visiting. Are we too far from their home now?
This sea is much too quiet. I'm uneasy. I mentioned this to one of the guys and he just laughed. I don't know whether I'm being mocked or not. I just hope I'm wrong...
I asked Captain Alpha if he thought anything felt strange to him. He laughed and said I worry too much. I hope he's right. He does have more experience than I do.

We were hit by a ferocious storm! The Thunder Bolt happened to be in the eye of the storm, which explains why the weather was so calm. No wonder those sea gulls stopped visiting. The storm will most likely get stronger. Will we survive this calamity?

When I opened my eyes, I was lying on a strange shore. The Thunder Bolt must be wrecked. I hope Captain Alpha and the others are okay, but I have to worry about myself. This island is covered in ice. I wrapped myself in a tattered sail I found. I still have my harpoon on me, so I can hunt. And at least I have my voyage log.

The island is covered in snow. I see some animals and plants but no sign of human life. Could this be a deserted island? I hope not. Anyway, it looks like rain. I should head inland and look for shelter of some sort.
I hid in a cave, but inside I found a dragon! I've only heard of them in tales... And now I see one frozen in ice. It has #bblack scales and four gold horns#k. If it wakes, I hope I can flee.

2.text: It has #bblack scales and four golden horns#k. Quite intimidating. I'm huddled in a nook near the entrance of the cave because I'm scared to go too close. If it awakens, I can flee outside.

1.text: Luckily, the Dragon hasn't woken up. I was visited by some friendly faces today. The sea gulls! They recognized me, I think. I fed them some fish, and then a brilliant idea came to me. I ripped a piece of my clothing and wrote a note to whomever, asking them to rescue me. Then I tied it around one of the sea gull's legs. I hope someone finds it.
Constant rain. I waited all day by the shore but didn't see a single ship. No one sails through the Karibbean Triangle, so I only have one hope. The sea gulls...
I saw a ship! It reached the shore within seconds. The sea gulls had surrounded the ship and guided it to me. It is indeed a rescue ship! I'm saved! My sea gulls saved my life!

0.text: #fnArial#A few years ago, there was a big fire in the Korean Folk Town. While everyone was busy putting out the fire, an important box that Chumji was safekeeping disappeared.

1.text: #fnArial#With the disappearance of the box that maintained the innocent of the Korean Folk Town, Chumji had no choice but to close the entrance to the town.

2.text: #fnArial#No one's entered Korean Folk Town ever since.

0.text: #fnArial#But just a few years later, Korean Folk Town suddenly started to change.

1.text: #fnArial#Kind Hongbu couldn't hold his anger, Kong Ji became lazy, and the Devoted Brothers envied each other.

2.text: #fnArial#Korean Folk Town grew twisted as people gradually began to change from their original stories. All of Ludibrium could be at risk if they keep diverging.

0.text: #fnArial#As things grew worse, Wiz, the Helios Tower Librarian, asked the Hero for help.

1.text: #fnArial#The Hero, summoned by Wiz's letter, made his way there to resolve the crisis. But his luggage was surprisingly heavy.

2.text: #fnArial#Upon arriving, the Hero discovered the librarian's assistant Moni in his luggage. Just as she was about to speak, they heard horrible moaning.

0.text: #fnArial#They followed the sound to Chumji, who had collapsed. With knowledge and courage, they created a medicine to wake Chumji.

1.text: #fnArial#They followed the sound to Chumji, who had collapsed. With knowledge and courage, they created a medicine to wake Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#The two find Hongbu at Nolbu's House, but unfortunately lose him as he chases Nolbu into the mountains.

1.text: #fnArial#While Moni was tending to the fallen Nolbu's wife, the Hero chased after Hongbu into the mountains first. Although the Hero tries to stop Hongbu in front of the Goblin House, he falls to Hongbu, who awakened from the gemstone's power.

0.text: #fnArial#As Hongbu tried to thwart Nolbu, Moni caught up just in time and rushed to block Nolbu.

1.text: #fnArial#But something strange happened. Who would've thought that the gemstone's energy would be sucked into Moni?

2.text: #fnArial#With the gemstone's weakened power in Hongbu, the Hero succeeded in defeating him. But Nolbu, who still hadn't come to his senses, kept snubbing Hongbu.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni, after listening to the story, couldn't suppress her anger and used Hongbu's spatula to knock Nolbu out.

1.text: #fnArial#Hongbu was reminded of how he'd once carried the then bed-wetting Nolbu home in his childhood.

2.text: #fnArial#Hongbu's anger faded, and he carried Nolbu back to town on his back. The Hero and Moni returned to Chumji with the #bStone of Rage#k Hongbu left.

0.text: #fnArial#Chumji explained what was going on as he stored the Stone of Rage. He also expressed surprise that Moni absorbed the gemstone's energy.

1.text: #fnArial#Hongbu was reminded of how he'd once carried the then bed-wetting Nolbu home in his childhood.

2.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni then started collecting 5 gemstones.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Regret#k was veiled upon Mr. Shim, who blamed himself for Shim Chung's disappearance.

1.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni went after the Qing Merchant and Oarsman, but could not find Shim Chung. As it happens, she'd been in the outhouse due to the prior day's meal.

2.text: #fnArial#Mr. Shim found his daughter and gave up the Stone. The Hero and Moni returned it to Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Gluttony#k was veiled over the tiger who liked Haenim's Mother's rice cakes.

1.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni then started collecting 5 gemstones.

2.text: #fnArial#The end of the tiger's gluttony came at the filthy hands of Haenim's Mother. The #bStone of Gluttony#k fell off the tiger, who ran away throwing up, and the Hero and Moni took it back to Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Envy#k was attached to both of the Devoted Brothers. The two were envious over one woman.

1.text: #fnArial#In order to the end the love triangle, Moni had both of them propose, but neither succeeded.

2.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Envy#k fell off the two brothers, unwound by brotherly love, and the Hero and Moni took it to Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#One day, while collecting the gemstones, Chumji told Moni about her past.

1.text: #fnArial#All this time, Moni thought that she was an orphan adopted by the library...but she was actually discovered in Korean Folk Town after a big fire.

2.text: #fnArial#Even Wiz, who knew every character, could not figure out who she was. So he and Chumji brought Moni to the Helios Tower Library, where she grew up.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni was quite composed, for she had assumed that there was some kind of reason, since she remembered nothing before that.

1.text: #fnArial#Will Moni's past be revealed when Korean Folk Town is safe? Moni, Chumji, and the Hero could only hope so.

2.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni began recovering the remaining 3 gemstones.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Greed#k was bound to the Lumberjack who bothered the God of Mountains every day for treasures.

1.text: #fnArial#In order to fix that terrible habit, the Hero and Nomi used a legend about a ghost.

2.text: #fnArial#After disguising themselves as ghosts with the help of the God, the #bStone of Greed#k fell off the Lumberjack.

0.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Sloth#k was bound to Kong Ji, who had grown lazy. The Hero and Moni decided to use the Magistrate to help her.

1.text: #fnArial#Kong Ji had accidentally brought the Magistrate together with a girl he liked, leading her to pine for him from afar.

2.text: #fnArial#The #bStone of Sloth#k fell off Kong Ji as she overcame her heartbreak. The Hero and Nomi took it to Chumji.

0.text: #fnArial#Now only the #bStone of Jealousy#k remained, but there was a fire behind the town, just like the one years back.

1.text: #fnArial#While the people were putting out the blaze, the Hero and Moni went into a hidden cave to find where the fire began.

2.text: #fnArial#Just as they identified it as a hideout, thanks to the gemstone-looking shapes on the cave floor, they saw a figure flee. So, the two gave chase.

0.text: #fnArial#The cave led to a cliff, where a maskless goblin was standing, infuriated that he failed the avenge the Nine-Tailed Fox.

1.text: #fnArial#Just in time, the people of Korean Folk Town had come to the cliff after putting out the fire. They were startled to see the goblin.

2.text: #fnArial#The goblin grew angrier still upon seeing Chumji, whom he blamed for the Nine-Tailed Fox's death. Seeking revenge, he embedded the Stone of Jealousy into his own body.

0.text: #fnArial#The Hero tried to stop the goblin, but was unable to stop him from awakening further. That was when Moni remembered her past.

1.text: #fnArial#Moni was the Nine-Tailed Fox, long thought dead. In the past blaze, it had become a human, later found by Wiz.

2.text: #fnArial#Moni realized why she was there. In order to pay for stealing the gemstones, she had come back as a human to fix the town.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni, memories recovered, approached the goblin. The energy of the gemstone seeped into her as she approached, but she withstood it.

1.text: #fnArial#The goblin knew that Moni was the Nine-Tailed Fox, and tried to keep her away from the gemstone. But he was unable to stop her.

2.text: #fnArial#The goblin, torn by Moni's agony, leapt from the cliff in order to stop the gemstone from harming her.

0.text: #fnArial#The Hero, who went to the bottom of the cliff after Moni, found her crying while holding onto the goblin, who closed his eyes forever in her arms.

#fnArial#Moni didn't come outside for a very long time after the Goblin died. After some time had passed like that, Moni was able to step outside once again with the strength gathered from the townspeople's consolations.

1.text: #fnArial#Chumji handed Moni the box with the collected gemstones. Korean Folk Town had no need for them any longer, thanks to everyone overcoming their faults and Spiegelmann's new safety measures.

0.text: #fnArial#The Hero and Moni returned to the Helios Tower Library and told the whole story to Wiz.

1.text: #fnArial#Wiz had already learned the news from his mentor Chumji. He expressed countless gratitude to the Hero.

2.text: #fnArial#And just like that, the crisis of Korean Folk Town was resolved.

0.text: #fnArial#Moni decided to record everything that she and the Hero went through in a book.

1.text: #fnArial#She was hoping that someday the tale of Moni and the Hero would help people.

2.text: #fnArial#Furthermore, she hoped that the book would make the Hero who rescued Korean Folk Town with their courage and kindness happy.

1.text: Writing a diary has been all the rage among humans lately, so I have decided to do the same.

2.text: But as a goddess, I thought a research log of my work would be more prudent.

1.text: I've begun developing a potion that causes the drinker to grow many times their normal size.

2.text: Any discoveries I might make can benefit others.

1.text: I believe I've finally found the right formula for the potion! The first batch is ready, so I plan to test its effectiveness soon.
Testing went...poorly, and this failure is disheartening. It's difficult to stay motivated.
I've decided to take a new approach with my research. I'm determined to find something that will help others!
My pride made me reckless. While I will take responsibility for my mistake, I fear it was too great for me to earn forgiveness. I may need help.

2.text: In addition, JM of Kerning City seems to harbor hatred for me. He is clearly opposed to my experiments.

1.text: Research is progressing smoothly, but I'm taking extra precautions to ensure there are no more mistakes.

2.text: I've tested the new formula with the first live plants, and the results are promising!

1.text: I was distracted today and mistakenly rinsed the potion remnants down the drain. My earlier caution was insufficient.

2.text: So little of the potion was actually left that I doubt anything will come of it, but there is still a nagging fear in the back of my mind.

1.text: Perhaps there was no reason for me to worry.

2.text: There's been no news of anything amiss as a result of my mistake.

In the blink of an eye, Maple World descended into chaos.
Try as the Explorers might, nothing could stop the all-consuming flames of war from engulfing everything. At the height of the fighting, Sayram, Lira, Kalix, Draken, and I steeled ourselves for a major battle at *** Stronghold. Once we began, there would be no turning back. Sayram did his best to keep the mood light, but we all knew this fight may be our last.

It wasn't until long after the smoke had finally cleared, that Sayram put his hand on my shoulder and told me the bitter truth. The world stood silent. *** was gone. Half the stronghold had vanished. The casualties were countless. Lira, Kalix, and Draken were missing, with no bodies to confirm our fears.

They'd known what this fight might cost them, but I couldn't reconcile this fact with my feelings. It was all too much. I realized that a single fish had no hope of swimming upstream. When I asked to leave, Sayram sent me on my way on the back of his Griffey, Stormclaw.

It's been a long time since I returned to El Nath. yet, my magic research remains fruitless and the brilliant white drifts have done nothing to ease my heavy heart. All I could do is make symbolic graves for the allies I never got the chance to bury... I wonder if Sayram is safe.

Sayram rode into El Nath on Stormclaw. His skin was hatched with a multitude of scars, but his spirit remained unbroken. He said ***'s weapon, ***, was coming for the decisive battle. With so many Explorers injured or dead, victory seemed unconceivable. I protested his going, knowing full well there was no point in doing so.

Sayram shook his head and asked me to enchant his shield. He planned to face *** alone. In his eyes, I saw the steely resolve of a man who would not be defeated. So I cast my best spells, while Stormclaw channeled its spirit into the shield. I also gave him the necklace that had saved my life at *** Stronghold. He thanked me and parted with a promise to return.

Some time later, news of Sayram's victory reached El Nath. I waited and waited, but Sayram did not return. One day, as I was toiling away at my experiments, I heard the beating of wings outside. Throwing down my research, I hurried outside to find Stormclaw alone. All I could do was stand there with my arms wrapped around his neck, and my face buried in his plumage.

Stormclaw dropped my necklace into my hands and departed for Minar Forest with Sayram's shield in tow. The war wasn't over yet. I can no longer allow myself to be carried away by the current when he gave his life to protect us all. The river is rapid, but I will swim with all my might nonetheless.

1.text: I'll pass my learnings on to Alcaster. Then, I must be going.

1.text: \nThe most terrifying part of that dungeon wasn't the shadows cast by the flickering torches.

3.text: My name is Cygnus. This is the first volume of my books that contain my thoughts. I am the emperor of Maple World although some call me the young empress.

1.text: He tried to destroy the entire world long time ago... There are hardly any documents left about him now. Things written about the Black Mage were so vile and evil that people didn't want to even think about it.

2.text: However, if the Black Mage is to be resurrected, that will truly be a nightmare no one wants to think about. Until now, a small group of elite knights have fought against the Black Mage, but the power of the mage is growing stronger.

1.text: It's a group of knights I created in order to defeat the Black Mage. They are called 'Cygnus Knights.' It's made up of people with different jobs and they fight against the Mage's followers. Lately, it seems like the knights are getting tired.

2.text: So I've been recruiting more knights. The Black Mage's followers are those who are trying to resurrect him.

1.text: Ereve... A drifting island that has been enabled by the spirit's power to float around. Because of the spirit's power and the power of the Shinsoo, any monsters or the Black Mage cannot enter. Once I'm ready to recruit more knights, I am planning to settle down in one spot and start recruiting.
Shinsoo is very large...probably about hundreds of times bigger than you. It's an organism of blessing. Following tradition, Maple's emperor is chosen by Shinsoo.

2.text: When the Shinsoo chooses a person, he or she becomes the emperor of Maple World and Shinsoo will always protect them and never abandon them.

1.text: A recording of the conversation I had with the book containing Cygnus' thoughts.

The Black Mage, who brought chaos to Maple World in the past, is about to be resurrected. According to our tactician, Neinheart, this state of peace will not last forever. Before the Black Mage is awoken again, we must grow our strength.

2.text: So in order to raise an army that will be able to fight against the Black Mage, I am recruiting for the Cygnus Knights.

1.text: Any maple adventurer can become a knight but there is one condition. You must at least be level 20 or higher to create a Cygnus Knight character.

2.text: The two characters connected by the spirit's power can help each other as their own levels advance.

1.text: The original character will gain a skill called the 'Spirit's Blessing.' This skill increases as the knight character's level increases.

2.text: #e#bThen can I volunteer for the knighthood right now?#k#n

3.text: No, not yet. We are still in the stage of preparation. The Chief Knights are working hard to finalize the recruitment process.

1.text: My faithful knight, Mihile, was born to be a warrior. He was given the spirit's blessing in order to fight evil. Those who first meet him say he's cold and intimidating, but he is my faithful knight with a good heart who is always protecting me.
Oz is a mage blessed by the spirit of fire. She is such a friendly and gentle mage. She gets in trouble by Irena sometimes because she forgets to do her job.

1.text: When it comes to cooking in Henesys, there's no ignoring the mush in the room. To say that this town's recipes include mushrooms does a grave disservice to the ingenuity of its people, who incorporate it into every dish they make. Be it the subtle fragrance of a dried mushroom stew or otherwise, I will share recipes key to any would-be chef of Henesys cuisine.

Ingredients

300g Orange Mushrooms 
Bacon (more is better) 
1/2 onion 
1 clove of garlic 
2 spoonfuls flour
500ml milk
Dash of salt and pepper

1. Slice the Orange Mushrooms, and finely chop the onion and garlic. 

2. Render the bacon in a large saucepot.

3. Saute the onion and garlic in the bacon fat on medium heat. 

4. Add the Orange Mushrooms and saute until softened.

0.text:
5. Add flour and stir for 1 minute until it thickens into a roux. 

6. Add milk a little at a time while stirring to prevent clumping. 

7. Simmer on low heat for approximately 10 minutes. 

8. Season to taste with salt and pepper. 

9. Bon appetite (while wondering if you added too much bacon).

1.text:
Ingredients

Orange Mushrooms 
Blue Mushrooms 
Green Mushrooms 
Horny Mushrooms 
1/2 onion
1/2 leek stalk 
Mixed herbs to taste 
800ml water 
150g meat of choice 
1 spoonful minced garlic

1. Destem the mushrooms, retain the caps. 
* Do NOT hesitate during Step 1...or else. 
(The 'or else' being that they'll leap out of your stockpot.) 

2. Roughly chop the onion and leek.

3. Add the herbs to your liking. (Too many may produce an undesirable medicinal quality.)

0.text:
4. Finely chop your meat of choice. 

5. Add everything to the pot and bring to a boil. 
* This process does not need to be elegant. Just toss it all in.

6. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until all ingredients are tender.

7. Bon appetite. (Results may vary.)

1.text:
Ingredients

Any type of Mushmom 
Olive oil as needed 
Dash of salt 
Dash of pepper

1. Wash the Mushmom in flowing water. 
* Resist the urge to chop it up.
As the name suggests, the Mushmom will be cooked whole to retain its juices

2. Brush the Mushmom with olive oil.

0.text:
3. Light and pre-heat a charcoal or a barbecue grill. 

4. Place the prepared Mushmom on the hot grill. 

5. Grill on all sides, ensuring each is thoroughly browned.

6. As soon as it begins leaking juices, remove from heat and season to taste with salt and pepper.

* Step 6 may take up to 2 hours. Patience is key.
Overcooking will lead toward a dry and tough texture.

7. Bon appetite. Serve warm and savor the smoky flavor.

1.text: One would be forgiven for assuming that a perpetual tundra like El Nath wouldn't have distinct local cuisine. However, this couldn't be further from the truth; one dinner in a fine El Nathian home will teach you that. Their dishes are in high in calories to combat the harsh clime and often features preserved fruit picked in the brief summertime.

0.text: In El Nath, one can eat glutinously to their heart's desire without fear of gaining weight. The following is a selection of those very same recipes. Enjoy.

1.text:
Ingredients 

300g reindeer meat (including fat)
50g lard or fat
1 onion 
2 carrots
2 potatoes
1 spoonful flour
Dash of salt and pepper 
Dried herbs to taste

1. Render fat in the a large stockpot.

2. Sear the reindeer meat in the rendered fat until browned. 

3. Add the onions and saute until translucent, then add the carrots and potatoes. 

4. Add the flour and stir for 1 minute until a roux has formed.

0.text:
5. Add water and stir to prevent clumping.

6. Add the salt, pepper, and herbs. 

7. Cover and simmer on low heat until all ingredients are tender.

8. Leave the stew on low heat, adding water as needed, and serve. Bon appetite.

1.text:
Ingredients 

300g Yeti fat
Dash of salt and pepper 
1 spoonful minced garlic
Dried herbs to taste

1. Clean the Yeti fat and roughly chop to bite-size pieces. 

2. Toss and coat the fat in the salt, pepper, garlic, and herbs. 

3. Add to a cold frying pan and bring to medium heat.

0.text:
4. Fry until the exterior is crisp.

5. Remove from heat and season to taste.

6. Store rendered fat for later use.

7. Eat with bread while warm. Bon appetite.

1.text:
Ingredients 

100g butter
100g brown sugar
2 large spoonfuls honey
50ml heavy cream
150g mixed nuts, chopped
50g dried cranberries

(Sheet pastry recipe omitted.) 

1. Add butter, brown sugar, honey, heavy cream, and salt to pot over medium heat. 

2. Once incorporated, lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes to thicken the caramel.

3. Mix in the chopped nuts and dried cranberries.

0.text:
4. Spread the filling on the parbaked sheet pastry.

5. Bake in an oven at 180 degrees Celsius until the crust is golden.

6. Remove from oven and let cool. Bon appetite. 
* Warning: Eating more than two slices in one sitting may lead to cavities.

1.text: Edelstein's lack of tourism is not only due to the region's turbulent political situation, but also its strange gastronomic sensibilities. As one local Explorer put it, 'There's one surefire way to force the Black Wings out: Invite them over for dinner.'

0.text: That said, Edelstein sausage is a genuine treat--even if it's hard to come by under the Black Wings occupation. So, if you fancy yourself an adventurous palate, here is a selection of local dishes. Enjoy (at your own risk).

1.text:
Ingredients 

4-6 Edelstein sausages
4 potatoes
80ml milk
2 cubes of butter
1/2 onion
1 spoonful flour
200ml meat broth
Dash of salt and pepper

1. Peel and boil the potatoes whole in a large stockpot. 

2. Mash the boiled potatoes, then add the milk, butter, salt, and pepper. Mix. 

3. In a frying pan, saute the onions in olive oil.

4. Add the flour and stir for 1 minute to from a roux.

0.text:
5. Add the broth and reduce until a thick sauce forms. Season to taste.

6. Roast the sausages for 20 minutes in a 180 degree Celsius oven. 

7. Move the sausages to a frying pan and reverse sear until browned on one side.

8. Plate the mashed potatoes, top with sausages, and cover in sauce. Bon appetite.

1.text:
Ingredients 

300g white fish
100g flour
Dash of baking powder 
150ml sparkling water
2-3 potatoes
Dash of salt and pepper

1. Cut the potatoes into thick planks, then soak in cold water for 30 minutes. 

2. Fill a pot with oil and heat to 160 degrees Celsius. 

3. Add potatoes and fry for 5-7 minutes, then strain. 

4. Cool briefly, then raise the temperature of the oil to 180 degrees and fry again.

0.text:
5. Salt the potatoes liberally.

6. Rub salt and pepper into both sides of the white fish.

7. In a bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, and salt together. 

8. Pour in cold sparkling water a little while stirring to thicken the batter.

9. Heat the pot of oil to 180 degrees Celsius. 

10. Batter the fish and fry until golden. 

11. Strain and salt liberally. Bon appetite.

Caution: Use ingredients sourced from outside of Edelstein if at all possible.

1.text:
Ingredients 

200g mixed Henesys Mushrooms, finely chopped
300g vegetable broth
100ml hydrated gelatin
100g fermented herb sausages
1 large spoonful whiskey 
1 large spoonful Edelstein sauce 
Dash of salt and pepper

1. Add the chopped Mushrooms and broth to a large stockpot and bring to a boil.

2. Once boiling, incorporate the whiskey and Edelstein sauce.

3. Add the gelatin and remove the heat.

4. Pour the liquid into a mold and let set for 2 hours to form the mushroom jelly.

0.text:
5. Remove the herb sausages from their casings and saute in a pan until crispy and crumbly.

6. Plate by slicing the mushroom jelly and top with sausage crumbles. Bon appetite.
* If you do not have Henesys Mushrooms, other varieties will suffice.

1.text: Up in the highlands of Perion, food is rather utilitarian. Since the Warriors there must be ready to fight at any time, there's little time to sit and enjoy fine dining. Instead, the focus has been on the creation of rations and the preservation of other foodstuffs.

0.text: The following selection of dishes features efficient nutrition and is perfect for the foodie on the go. Enjoy.

1.text:
Ingredients 

500g dried meat
250g animal fat
100g dried fruit (cranberries and/or blueberries are recommended)
50g nuts
Salt

1. Grind the dried meat as finely as possible into a powder. 

2. Cut the fat into small pieces and render in a pot over low heat. 

3. Add the meat powder, dried fruit, and nuts into the melted fat and mix. 

4. If you'd like to add any spices, do so now.

0.text:
5. Lower the heat. Once cool enough to handle, shape the mixture into balls.

6. Let dry at the top of Mount Perion. Bon appetite.
* Served plain, it will often taste like sawdust, so it is recommended to be eaten with another dish like fried bread.

1.text:
Ingredients 

2 cups flour
Dash of baking powder 
Dash of salt

1. Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt.

2. Stir in warm water a little at a time to form a dough.
* Be wary of Iron Hog attacks during preparation.

3. Let the dough rise for 30 minutes, then divide into 6-8 parts.

4. Pound out each dough ball into a flat disk.

0.text:
5. Heat oil in a pot and add the dough. 

6. Fry until both sides are golden. 

7. Remove from the oil and eat with rations. Bon appetite.
* Feel free to spread condiments onto the bread as well.

1.text:
Ingredients 

Any meat with tendons and fat removed 
Stumpy wood

1. Cut meat into 2x5cm strips.

2. Tie the meat strips together and place on a wire grill.

3. Slowly cook over a fire of Stumpy wood for 24 hours.

4. Remove meat from heat and let dry on in a shaded tent with proper circulation.

0.text:
5. Wait a month. Meat should be hard and log-like.

6. Chop into pieces with an axe, then pound down the meat into a powder.

7. Collect and store the powder in a pouch for later use.

8. To prepare, boil some water, add salt and the meat powder.

9. Once incorporated, gulp it down in one go. Bon appetite.

Long ago lived a boy named Paku. Every day, Paku stared into the sky, longing to fly like the birds do.

Nothing could shake his fascination, be it the changing of the seasons or the pleas of friends.

'If only I could fly...' he'd say.

At some point that erstwhile dream became a goal. So he focused, stared hard into the sky to study how the birds made flight.

His eyes began to dim. The harsh sun and cold winds slowly took their toll, but Paku did not avert his gaze.

Eventually, the light left Paku's eyes entirely. He could no longer see the birds, and his memory of them began to fade in turn.

'All I'd ever wanted was...' 

Paku wept, but tears would not save him. The world he'd dreamed of seeing from above had vanished.

1.text: There's a secret hidden beneath the ground. Under the biggest maple tree in Henesys is where it's found. Deep deep down, was an enormous Strawberry Slime! Big as could be and loud as a chime. One day a very hungry piglet smelled something and dug near the tree. 'Whatever could it be?' Just then its snout bumped into the slime, and the piglet gave it a slurp.

0.text: The Strawberry Slime rose from the ground with a burp. The townsfolk nearby screamed and in fear, but the piglet didn't roar. Instead, it ate and ate until the slime was no more. 1.text: In Perion lived an axe, sharp but small. The other axes were used to chop wood or fight monsters, but the little axe got no use at all. The problem was, it was much too tiny. It dreamed of being useful someday, but dared not be whiny.

0.text: Then, a giant Fire Boar came to town. It raged and tried to burn everything down. The other axes dared not fight. 'What if my handle is set alight?!' But the little axe yelled out. 'Throw me at its snout!' With a flick of a wrist, the little axe flew to its nose. The boar reeled back, coughing in its throes. At last, it fell, but not before one last 'achoo!' Where in the world is Dr. De Lang? All I asked for were ingredients, and yet he's been absent for five days and counting. When I considered it, he did leave in a hurry with some old books under each arm. While the books are like him, the rush is not.

0.text: Thinking he'd gotten mixed up in some preposterous business again, I reported it to Alcadno Society HQ, but Maed just brushed me off, saying 'He'll find his way back.'

1.text: He's still gone. This certainly isn't like him. So I looked around De Lang's lab and found a report: 'The Effects of Magic on Mental Processes.' Magic? We're alchemists, not magicians. What is this doing here?

0.text: Another of his journals was filled from cover to cover with arcane letters and complex pentacles. The only thing I could make heads or tails of said there was a lab in the forgotten underground passage. I have no sense of what to make of this, but I can't shake my unease nonetheless.

1.text: I went to De Lang's home in search of answers. The entrance was sealed, but I forced my way in. I found magic residue scattered around, like an explosion had occurred. His equipment had rusted and broken glass was strewn about. Just what happened, De Lang?

Today, I went to see Han the Broker. I enquired if he'd heard any news of De Lang. After thinking a moment, he said he saw someone suspicious (not me) near De Lang's home. I asked him if knew of a lab in the underground passage, but he just tilted his head in confusion. Is it such a secret that even Han doesn't know of it?

I made an effort to make sense of the pentacles I found in De Lang's notes. Cross-referencing some tomes in the archives, I found a match... An ancient pentacle for mind control! A tool for subjugating another to one's will. Why would he need this?

0.text: [The remainder has been rendered illegible with age.]
[It's a complaint letter left by an Explorer who visited the Temple of Time.]

That darn Sorcerer, or whatever they call themselves, is a no-good miser. Gave me a whole rigmarole about needing to melt the frozen heart, and I found out he's been selling a potion of instant death to folks for a million Mesos.

It's the perfect con, honestly. People'll buy it, drink it, and there won't be anyone left to report the crime. But that ends today, bucko. Oh, and watch out for the caretaker. They might be in cahoots. Personally, I didn't trust those shifty-looking glasses from the start.

More and more people are saying they heard the voice from the holy light. Not just the Alliance leaders and heroes, but those who have just started their journeys too. I've no idea where this power comes from or what it desires. All that can be certain is that it appearing just as we face our ultimate enemy cannot be a coincidence.

We've come to call this power 'Determination.' If we are to win this war, then I as the tactician will do what I must make it so. We will gather the scattered Determination into a single vessel and see if it can achieve the impossible.
I have never been one to believe in miracles, but considering our opposition, I'm uncharacteristically open to the idea.
Reports have been pouring in about Alliance soldiers disappearing from the frontlines. When eventually found, they've been bound by black chains and left barely hanging onto their lives.

This is undoubtedly the Black Mage's attempt to weaken our forces. And as this battle wears on, I'm sure he'll test our Alliance with far more heinous methods. For now, though, we need to up our search and rescue efforts.

I only pray we're not too late...

The Alliance has been telling us old folks to evacuate to a safe location. It's a load of malarkey if you ask me. Yes, the danger is real, but I'm the greatest pilot Maple World's ever seen. What's more, word is that the battle is taking place up in the sky somewhere.

Is there really no role for me in this, other than to run? I may not be able to fight, but I could always run supplies. And I'll bet you I can do it faster than any whippersnapper. It'll be my battle to keep everyone topped up, and I'm not about to lose.

The Flame Birds of the Vanishing Journey is a mysterious creature of both great intellect as well as enormous power. They can incinerate objects with a beat of their wings and fly endlessly. Nobody knows where they came from, though, some suspect they are born of the most noble Erdas.
Recently, I heard chirping near the outpost. I went to check, assuming I'd find a sparrow.

But no! Instead, it was small Flame Bird. I've only ever known them to be massive, but this one could fit in the palm of my hand. It looked so pitiful, I bent down and picked it up. Just then it exerted a shining light. I closed my eyes tight to protect them.

When I opened them again, there was cold air hitting my cheeks. Somehow, some way, I was riding on a Flame Bird across the sky. Each flap of its great red wings sent a rush of air my way. But something perplexed me. I'd always been told the Flame Bird was burning hot, yet, here I was riding on it no worse for wear. In fact, its warmth seemed almost...compassionate.

The Alliance sent me an urgent message. It was for cannonballs or something. The messenger said all this stuff about the enemy and strategy and stuff. Honestly, I dozed off so I don't remember most of it now.

The messenger kept saying this wouldn't be easy and that I may die. They said to make sure to keep anyone out who wasn't supposed to be there. That part I get. That's what I do. That's what I've always done. And that's what I'll keep doing.

What...is this? This crystal is larger than I could've ever imagined. 

Its strange aura seems to barely be holding back the black mist.

So the Holychorus wasn't only legend? 

All these cracks and broken fragments... It's severely damaged.

The Holychorus sealed this tunnel, but I can see...something beyond it. A strange world with purple skies and foreign castles. 

What was that flash? Did something just pass by? An illusion? No. I would stake my life that it's not.

Is the world beyond crossing over due to the state of the Holychorus? Or is that what caused its fragmentation? 

It gives me chills. This can't be real, can it?

I need to report this right away. 

But how do I even begin to explain what I am seeing? The seal... It's falling apart.

My hands won't stop shaking. I need to confirm. I need to run. 

This...isn't what I wanted.

Muse! At last, the day of the Deep Sea exploration! There were some issues with the chief's equipment, so only Chuck, Quincy, and I will be going. I'm sure it'll be fine, but if anything does happen, we'll come right back up to tell the chief. The Sea Witch will regret calling us fools when she sees what we achieve today.
Okay, enough rambling! I'm writing you this letter in case anything happens. I didn't want to leave any regrets behind. But I'm sure nothing will, and we'll laugh about this together later.

I wanted to tell you how grateful I am for you. You once told me you liked me because I was kind and loved the ocean. I thought those were trivial reasons then, but now I know that you were seeing me, for me.
I wanted to be that person for you, so I joined this expedition. Because I love Aquarium, I love the ocean, and I love our life together.

There are things I can't stop thinking about lately: how eagerly I await our reunion, and how happy I am to protect what's precious to me. When I return, I'm going to pull you into my arms and finally confess everything I feel for you. I can't wait.

1.text: #bSanta Family Tree#k

2.text: Very little is known about Santa Claus's family, other than his wife.

3.text: According to S.Y. Johnson, Director of Sales at the Maple Herald, and one of the top journalists in all of Maple World, there IS a small cadre of people who speak to Santa Claus directly once every year.

0.text: Johnson could not reveal the names of anyone involved, but he was very resolved on their reliability. He was even able to provide a small anecdote from Santa's life.

When Santa Claus made his first trip to Finland, he saw a beautiful woman working alone on Christmas Eve in an old sock factory. She was a poor woman, from a poor neighborhood, where children did not even have socks of their own to hang on the chimneys for Christmas Eve. Many of them did not even have chimneys!

This lovely woman, with a heart of gold, stayed up the entire night to weave socks for every child in her neighborhood. When Santa Claus saw her, it was love at first sight. It's said that he proposed to her that very night. The couple then started their new life in Happyville, on the day after Christmas, but she would only move on one condition... Mrs. Claus would make socks in the Santa's factory for all the Maplers in Maple World.

1.text: #bChristmas Socks#k

2.text: If there's one Christmas tradition that Maplers go gaga for every year, it's getting presents in their Christmas Socks. Unlike the ridiculously named 'stockings' of other worlds, these Socks are made from enchanted weavings that act as a sort of beacon for Santa Claus.

0.text: Once hung on a chimney, they continuously fill the air with cheer and joy, feeding off of the good deeds done by their owners each year.
A Christmas Sock must meet many standards in order to entice Old St. Nic. They must be strong, ample, and never worn to the gym.

1.text: The standard in all sock-making was set, of course, by Mrs. Claus herself. Her designs from the Happyville sock factory can hold any size, shape, or weight, and truly remain on the forefront of sock technology.

0.text: The following pages contain her two guidelines for producing a quality sock.

1. The Right Frame: The frame is the basic pattern and master key used to make all socks of the same, and correct size. The artisan who first created the sock's unique shape has long since retired, but Mrs. Claus is willing to lend frames from her personal collection upon request.

2. The Right Knitting Ball: The qualified knitting ball is the only sanctioned material for creating socks of the proper caliber. This specific batch of twine is only possessed by NooNoo the Snowman, who roams freely about Happyville. Accept no substitutes in this material, or your sock will only be good for getting lost in the laundry!

1.text: #bSanta Claus, Who Is He? #k

2.text: There is only one person, outside the residents of Happyville, who has made contact with Santa Claus. According to source S.Y. Johnson, Santa has made contact with a reporter at the Maple Herald.

0.text: From analysis of history, and his annual reports, some facts can be ascertained. Santa Claus is most definitely an optimistic and giving person. His description as a large, and bearded gentleman is accurate, and he is known to have twinkling eyes. It is believed that only Mrs. Claus has seen the true face of her dear husband.

When the busy Christmas season is over, Santa Claus is known to reply to letters from children all over the world. He spends a great deal of time caring for his reindeer and making repairs to his sleigh. And, of course, much of his time is spent preparing next year's Naughty or Nice list.

According to reports, this Christmas has been particularly busy for the crimson dynamo, and he has been seen relaxing at the tree in Happyville to regain his Christmas cheer. Nothing brings the man joy more than giving presents to children, and admiring the majesty of a well-lit evergreen.

But one troubling fact sticks out from this information. Maplers across the world do not believe in Santa like they used to. Santa himself has expressed his wish for Maplers all over to believe in the spirit of Christmas, and to spread his message of love across all of Maple World. Mrs. Claus has even sent out a call for letters, to show support for the man in red.

1.text: #bGood Deeds and You#k

2.text: In case the reader is unfamiliar with the ways of being nice to others, a few simple tasks can put you in St. Nic's good graces.

0.text: The following is a list of \nSanta-approved good deeds:

1.text:
- Help your parents with a problem
- Study hard
- Do something nice for your siblings and friends
- Obey traffic laws
- Do not use vulgar words
- Do not tell lies
- Do not be greedy
- Be nice to animals

0.text: Once your deeds are done, and the goodness is in your heart, you will want to prepare for presents!

1.text: First, craft or procure the correct Christmas Socks.

2.text: Second, hang these Socks by the chimney.

3.text: Third, continue to do as many good deeds as you can, to show Santa Claus how much you believe in Christmas.

0.text: There are many other things you can do to gain Santa's favor. And a little fame never hurts when you're competing with a list the size of the entire world. Do every Christmas quest you can, and Santa is sure to shine his light upon you!

1.text: Have fun and happy holidays!
#bAppendix : Santa Claus town in Finland#k

2.text: According to the Maple Herald, Santa Claus lives in a town called Rovaniemi in Finland. This is where he can be found, taking care of his reindeer and preparing for his annual jaunt across the globe.

0.text: As the Christmas season approaches, millions of letters pour into the town, and Santa does his best to write back to every single one of them.

Any Maplers who wish to contact Santa Claus can send their letters to the following address: 
 Santa Claus - Main Post Office 
 96930 Napapiiri, Finland.

1.text: #bRosy Cheeks and a Big Heart#k

2.text: Little real information is known about Santa Claus. This red-suited father of Christmas has made his tour around the world with his sleigh and reindeer (Rudolph included), putting gifts under trees and hanging from chimneys alike.

0.text: But a document discovered in Germany may have the secrets this festive dynamo! From the excerpts of what appears to be a Diary of Santa Claus, even the big man himself did not seem to know why he started giving out presents to children.

1.text: Experts examining the diary believe that Santa was experiencing recurring dreams. They predicted that this could be the key to unravelling the secrets of Santa Claus!

0.text: The following is a page from his diary referring to the dream.

1.text: What a jolly, jumping time! Tonight I dreamed the dream I always have, and it was just as wonderful as it always is! Twas the 6th of December, in the great land of Turkey. I rode my flying horse through the sky, hunting with a band of my greatest friends, the divine beings! And what a funny bunch they were, laughing and calling me Odin, their lord supreme!

0.text: Tired from our hunt, and wanting for rest, we set down on the roof of a beautiful home to let our horses catch their breath. And lo, what did I find? A bounty of boots hung by the chimney, all piled high with heaps of carrots, grass, and sugar! Twas as if they had known we would visit their rooftop all along! With our horses well fed and our spirits high, we left them treats of our own. Candies and gifts for the children of the house.

Twas a beautiful dream, but one that changed! As we flew across the world, my followers called me many different names. When we reached Germany, they called me Saint Nicolas! In the Netherlands, they called me Sinterklass. It's funny that all of these names sound like my original name, Santa Claus. Ho ho ho!

1.text: Unfortunately, my dream ended as it always did, with Johnson, my Director of Sales, coming to tell me about the latest quotas...

1.text: It'll serve as a lovely pet to you for the next 30 days.

2.text: Once 30 days pass and the Water of Life is used up, you can gather up the #bWater of Life#k by meeting up with a fairy in #bMarr's Forest#k to revive your pet. 1.text: \n90여일간 당신의 곁에서 사랑스러운 펫으로 지낼 것입니다.

2.text: 90일이 지나 생명수가 다 마르면 당신은 #b캐시샵#k에서 판매하는 #r프리미엄 생명의 물#k을 구해 인형상태의 펫을 바로 부활시킬 수 있습니다.

3.text: 조련사나 펫 먹이 상인을 찾아가 펫의 먹이를 먹이고 명령어를 사용하여 펫과의 친밀도를 높여보세요.

0.text: 펫 명령어 안내서 : 쁘띠 진 힐라와 아이들 펫\n

1.text:
펫 레벨 : 1 ~ 30
말해봐,말해,말해줘
때찌,안돼,혼난다,혼날래
사랑해
응가
자자,졸립지,쿨쿨,잘자

0.text: Tip. 펫의 레벨이 15가 되면 특정 말을 하도록 시킬 수 있습니다. \n #b예) /펫 [할 말]#k
